so: Qeex doorarkaaga, kadibna hoostooda ku dar shaqaale

English: Could not load profile. Please refresh.
am: መገለጫውን መጫን አልተቻለም። እባክዎ ገጹን ያድሱ።
om: Piroofaayilii fe'uu hin dandeenye. Maaloo haaromsi.
so: Profile lama rari karin. Fadlan cusboonaysii.

English: You are online — orders can reach you
am: በመስመር ላይ ነዎት — ትዕዛዞች ሊደርሱዎት ይችላሉ
om: Interneetii irra jirta — ajajni sitti ga'uu danda'a
ti: ኣብ መስመር ኣለኻ — ትእዛዛት ክበጽሑኻ ይኽእሉ
so: Waad onlayn tahay — dalabyadu way kuu soo gaadhi karaan

English: You are offline — no new orders will come in
am: ከመስመር ውጭ ነዎት — አዲስ ትዕዛዝ አይመጣም
om: Interneetii alaa jirta — ajajni haaraan hin dhufu
ti: ኣብ መስመር የለኻን — ሓደስቲ ትእዛዛት ኣይመጹን
so: Waad offline tahay — dalabyo cusub ma iman doonaan

English: Order declined. The customer will be refunded.
am: ትዕዛዙ ውድቅ ተደርጓል። ለደንበኛው ገንዘቡ ይመለሳል።
so: Dalabka waa la diiday. Macmiilka waa la soo celinayaa.

English: ready for pickup — courier and customer notified
am: ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ — ሹፌሩ እና ደንበኛው ተነግሯቸዋል
om: fudhachuuf qophii — ergamaa fi maamilaaf beeksifameera
so: diyaar u ah qaadasho — qaadaha iyo macmiilka waa la ogeysiiyay

English: Confirm that the courier has picked up this order?
om: Ergamaan ajaja kana akka fudhate mirkaneessuu?
ti: ኣብጻሒ እዚ ትእዛዝ ከም ዝወሰደ ትረጋግጽ ዲኻ?
so: Ma xaqiijisaa in qaadaha uu qaaday dalabkan?

English: Pickup confirmed! Order is now in transit.
am: መውሰዱ ተረጋግጧል! ትዕዛዙ አሁን በጉዞ ላይ ነው።
om: Fudhachuun mirkanaa'eera! Ajajni amma karaarra jira.
ti: ምውሳድ ተረጋጊጹ! ትእዛዝ ሕጂ ኣብ መገዲ ኣሎ።
so: Qaadashada waa la xaqiijiyay! Dalabka hadda wuu socdaa.

English: Could not refresh - check your connection
om: Haaromsuu hin dandeenye - walqunnamtii kee ilaali

English: Marked sold out for today - it returns tomorrow
am: ለዛሬ አልቋል ተብሎ ተመዝግቧል - ነገ ይመለሳል
om: Har'aaf dhumeera jedhamee mallatteeffameera - boru deebi'a
so: Waxaa loo calaamadeeyay dhammaaday maanta - berrito ayuu soo laaban doonaa
Magaca iyo taleefanka waa loo baahan yahay.
Magaca doorka waa loo baahan yahay.

English: Printer connected! Kitchen tickets will print directly to it.
am: ፕሪንተሩ ተገናኝቷል! የኩሽና ትኬቶች በቀጥታ ይታተማሉ።
om: Maashinii maxxansaa walqabateera! Tikeetiin kichuu kallattiin ni maxxanfama.
ti: ሕታም ተራኺቡ! ትኬታት ምድሪ ብቀጥታ ይሕተም።
so: Daabacaha waa ku xiran yahay! Tigidhada jikadu si toos ah ayay u daabacmi doonaan.

English: Fast food, groceries & packages across all 12 Hawassa zones.
am: ፈጣን ምግብ፣ ግሮሰሪ እና ጥቅሎች በሁሉም 12 የሀዋሳ ዞኖች።
om: Nyaata ariifataa, nyaata mana keessaa fi qoodota naannoowwan Hawaasaa 12 hunda keessatti.
ti: ቅልጡፍ መግቢ፡ መግቢ ገዛን ፓኬጅን ኣብ ኩለን 12 ከባብታት ሃዋሳ።
so: Cunto degdeg ah, raashin & xirmooyin dhammaan 12-ka aag ee Hawaasa.
12 aag oo Hawaasa ah ayaa la daboolay

English: Phone Number, EtelID or Etel Code
am: ስልክ ቁጥር፣ EtelID ወይም Etel Code
om: Lakkoofsa bilbilaa, EtelID ykn Koodii Etel
ti: ቁጽሪ ተሌፎን፡ EtelID ወይ ኮድ ኢትኤል
so: Lambarka taleefanka, EtelID ama Koodhka Etel

English: Recommended — One ID for all ETEL services
om: Kan filatame — ID tokko tajaajila ETEL hundaaf
ti: ዝተመክረ — ሓደ ID ንኩሉ ኣገልግሎት ኢትኤል
so: La xushay — Hal ID oo adeegyada ETEL oo dhan
Gaarsiin · Safar · Lacag bixin — hal aqoonsi
Gal si aad u sii wadato

English: Go online and start earning across all Hawassa zones.
am: ኦንላይን ይሁኑና በሁሉም የሀዋሳ ዞኖች ገቢ ማግኘት ይጀምሩ።
om: Interneetii irratti ba'iitii naannoowwan Hawaasaa hunda keessatti argachuu eegali.
ti: ኣብ መስመር እቶ ኣብ ኩለን ከባብታት ሃዋሳ ምርካብ ጀምር።
so: Onlayn noqo oo bilow inaad kasbato dhammaan aaggaga Hawaasa.

English: Safe, affordable rides across all Hawassa zones.
am: ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ፣ ተመጣጣኝ ጉዞ በሁሉም የሀዋሳ ዞኖች።
om: Imala nagaa, gatii laafaa naannoowwan Hawaasaa hunda keessatti.
ti: ውሑስ፡ ርካሽ ጉዕዞ ኣብ ኩለን ከባብታት ሃዋሳ።
so: Safarro ammaan ah oo jaban dhammaan aaggaga Hawaasa.

English: Pick up and deliver orders across all Hawassa zones.
am: ትዕዛዞችን በሁሉም የሀዋሳ ዞኖች ውስጥ ይውሰዱ እና ያድርሱ።
om: Ajajoota naannoowwan Hawaasaa hunda keessatti fudhadhuu fi geessi.
ti: ኣብ ኩለን ከባብታት ሃዋሳ ትእዛዛት ውሰድን ኣቕርብን።
so: Qaad oo gaarsii dalabyada dhammaan aaggaga Hawaasa.

English: Manage your shop and orders across all Hawassa zones.
am: የእርስዎን ሱቅ እና ትዕዛዞች ያስተዳድሩ በሁሉም የሀዋሳ ዞኖች።
om: Suuqa kee fi ajajoota naannoowwan Hawaasaa hunda keessatti bulchi.
ti: ድኳንካን ትእዛዛትካን ኣብ ኩለን ከባብታት ሃዋሳ ኣመሓድር።
so: Maaree dukaankaaga iyo dalabyada dhammaan aaggaga Hawaasa.

English: One sign-in for every ETEL app. We open the right one for your account.
am: ለሁሉም የኢትኤል መተግበሪያዎች አንድ መግቢያ። ለመለያዎ ትክክለኛውን እንከፍታለን።
om: Seensi tokko appii ETEL hundaaf. Akkaawuntii keessaniif kan sirrii ni baneena.
ti: ሓደ መእተዊ ንኹሉ ኣፕታት ኢትኤል። ንኣካውንትካ ዝምልከት ንከፍት።
so: Hal gelitaan oo ah dhammaan abkaha ETEL. Waxaan furnaa kan akoonkaaga ku habboon.
Ma u baahan tahay app gaar ah?

English: Rides are for you — Delivery is for your packages
am: ጉዞ ለእርስዎ ነው — ዴሊቨሪ ለጥቅሎችዎ ነው
om: Imalli kan keeti — Geessuun ba'aa keetiif
ti: ጉዕዞ ንዓኻ እዩ — ምቕራብ ንጥቅልታትካ እዩ
so: Safarku adiga ayuu kaa dhigan yahay — Gaarsiintu waa xirmooyinkaaga

English: — no destination? Tell the driver on the way
am: — መድረሻ የለም? በመንገድ ላይ ለሾፌሩ ይንገሩት
om: — bakki ga'umsaa hin jiruu? Karaa irratti konkolaachisaa himi
ti: — መዕለቢ የለን ዶ? ኣብ መንገዲ ንሾፌር ንገሮ
so: — meel aad tegayso ma jirto? U sheeg darawalka jidka

English: Tap the map to set pickup & drop-off, or type above
am: መነሻና መድረሻ ለማዘጋጀት ካርታውን ይንኩ ወይም ከላይ ይጻፉ
om: Fudhachuu fi gadi-dhiisuu kaa'uuf kaartaa tuqi, yookaan olitti barreessi
ti: ንምቕባልን ምዝታይን ካርታ ተንክፍ ወይ ኣብ ላዕሊ ጽሓፍ
so: Taabo khariidadda si aad u dejiso qaadashada iyo dhigitaanka, ama ku qor kor

English: Final fare is based on the actual distance your driver travels, from pickup to drop-off — this is just an estimate.
am: የመጨረሻው ዋጋ ሾፌሩ ከመነሻ እስከ መድረሻ በሚጓዘው ትክክለኛ ርቀት ላይ ይመሰረታል — ይህ ግምት ብቻ ነው።
om: Kaffaltiin xumuraa fageenya dhugaa konkolaachisaan imalu irratti hundaa'a, bakka fudhachuu irraa hanga gadi-dhiisuutti — kun tilmaama qofa.
ti: መወዳእታ ዋጋ ብሓቂ ሾፌር ዝጓዓዘሉ ርሕቀት ካብ መቐበሊ ክሳብ መዝተይ እዩ — እዚ ግምት ጥራይ እዩ።
so: Qiimaha ugu dambeeya wuxuu ku salaysan yahay masaafada dhabta ah ee darawalku safro, laga bilaabo qaadashada ilaa dhigitaanka — kani waa qiyaas oo kaliya.

English: Our team reviews every report. Select what happened:
am: ቡድናችን ሁሉንም ሪፖርቶች ይመረምራል። የሆነውን ይምረጡ፦
om: Garreen keenya gabaasa hunda ilaala. Wanti ta'e filadhu:
ti: ጉጅለና ነፍሲ ወከፍ ጸብጻብ ይገምግም። እንታይ ከም ዝኾነ ምረጽ፦
so: Kooxdayadu waxay eegtaa warbixin kasta. Dooro wixii dhacay:

English: Tap the map or type where you are and where you're going. No GPS? Use the Quick zones.
am: ያሉበትንና የሚሄዱበትን ቦታ ካርታው ላይ ይንኩ ወይም ይጻፉ። ጂፒኤስ የለም? ፈጣን ቦታዎችን ይጠቀሙ።
om: Kaartaa tuqi yookaan bakka jirtuu fi bakka deemtu barreessi. GPS hin qabduu? Aanaalee ariifataa fayyadami.
ti: ካርታ ተንክፍ ወይ ኣብ ኣበይ ከም ዘለኻን ናበይ ከም እትኸይድን ጽሓፍ። GPS የብልካን ድዩ? ቅልጡፍ ዞናት ተጠቐም።
so: Taabo khariidadda ama qor halka aad joogto iyo halka aad tegayso. GPS ma haysatid? Isticmaal Aagagga degdegga ah.

English: Pick Bajaj, Moto or Car and see the fare for your trip before you book. Pay cash, wallet or Chapa.
am: ባጃጅ፣ ሞተር ወይም መኪና ይምረጡና ከመያዝዎ በፊት የጉዞዎን ዋጋ ይመልከቱ። በጥሬ ገንዘብ፣ በዋሌት ወይም በቻፓ ይክፈሉ።
om: Bajaaj, Moto yookaan Konkolaataa filadhu, osoo hin qabsiisin gatii imala keetii ilaali. Maallaqa harkaa, Waalet yookaan Chapa'n kaffali.
ti: ባጃጅ፣ ሞተር ወይ መኪና ምረጽ ቅድሚ ምምዝጋብካ ዋጋ ጉዕዞኻ ርአ። ብጥረ ገንዘብ፣ ዋሌት ወይ Chapa ክፈል።
so: Dooro Bajaaj, Moto ama Baabuur oo arag qiimaha safarkaaga ka hor intaadan dalban. Ku bixi lacag caddaan, wallet ama Chapa.

English: This immediately notifies ETEL support with your role, location, and current trip (if any). Use this if you feel unsafe or something is wrong right now.
am: ይህ ወዲያውኑ የእርስዎን ሚና፣ አካባቢና የአሁኑን ጉዞ (ካለ) ለኢትኤል ድጋፍ ያሳውቃል። ደህንነት ካልተሰማዎት ወይም አሁን የሆነ ችግር ካለ ይህን ይጠቀሙ።
om: Kun battalumatti deeggarsa ETEL gaheen kee, bakki kee fi imala yeroo ammaa (yoo jiraate) beeksisa. Yoo of eegannoo dhabde yookaan wanti dogoggoraa amma jiraate kana fayyadami.
ti: እዚ ብቕጽበት ንደገፍ ETEL ሚናኻ፣ ቦታኻን ናይ ሕጂ ጉዕዞኻን (እንተለዎ) የፍልጦ። ድሕነት እንተ ስኢንካ ወይ ሕጂ ዝኾነ ጌጋ እንተ ኣሎ እዚ ተጠቐም።
so: Tani isla markiiba ayay ku ogeysiisaa taageerada ETEL doorkaaga, goobtaada iyo safarkaaga hadda (haddii jiro). Isticmaal haddii aadan amaan ahayn ama wax qaldan hadda.

English: Check the driver's name and plate, share your trip, and use SOS any time.
am: የሾፌሩን ስምና ታርጋ ያረጋግጡ፣ ጉዞዎን ያጋሩ፣ እንዲሁም በማንኛውም ጊዜ SOS ይጠቀሙ።
om: Maqaa fi dirree konkolaachisaa mirkaneessi, imala kee qoodi, SOS yeroo kamiyyuu fayyadami.
ti: ስም ሾፌርን ሰሌዳን ኣረጋግጽ፣ ጉዕዞኻ ኣካፍል፣ SOS ኣብ ዝኾነ ግዜ ተጠቐም።
so: Hubi magaca iyo taarikada darawalka, wadaag safarkaaga, oo isticmaal SOS mar kasta.

om: Kaffaltii kee duraa irra deebi'ee ilaalaa jira…
so: Dib u hubinta lacag bixintaadii hore…
Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad ETEL la safartay! 🚗

English: Old ride cancelled — booking new one…
am: የቀድሞው ጉዞ ተሰርዟል — አዲስ በመያዝ ላይ…
om: Imalli duraa haqameera — kan haaraa qabsiisaa jira…
ti: ዝነበረ ጉዕዞ ተሰሪዙ — ሓድሽ ይምዝገብ ኣሎ…
so: Safarkii hore waa la tirtiray — mid cusub ayaa la dalbanayaa…

English: Network error — could not cancel. Please try again.
am: የኔትወርክ ችግር — መሰረዝ አልተቻለም። እባክዎ እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Rakkoo neetwoorkii — haquu hin dandeenye. Maaloo irra deebi'ii yaali.
ti: ጌጋ መርበብ — ክስረዝ ኣይተኻእለን። በጃኻ ደጊምካ ፈትን።
so: Qalad shabakad — lama tirtiri karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.

English: Could not find your phone number. Please pay cash.
am: ስልክ ቁጥርዎን ማግኘት አልተቻለም። እባክዎ በጥሬ ገንዘብ ይክፈሉ።
om: Lakkoofsi bilbilaa kee hin argamne. Maaloo maallaqa harkaa kaffali.
ti: ቁጽሪ ተሌፎንካ ኣይተረኽበን። በጃኻ ብጥረ ገንዘብ ክፈል።
so: Lambarka taleefankaaga lama helin. Fadlan ku bixi lacag caddaan.

English: Set a drop-off place, or choose a distance in km
am: መድረሻ ያዘጋጁ ወይም ርቀቱን በኪ.ሜ ይምረጡ
om: Bakka gadi-dhiisuu kaa'i, yookaan fageenya km filadhu
ti: ቦታ መዝተይ ኣቐምጥ ወይ ርሕቀት ብኪሜ ምረጽ
so: Dhig meesha dhigitaanka, ama dooro masaafo km ah

English: Check that the driver’s name and plate number match what’s shown in the app before getting in.
am: ከመግባትዎ በፊት የሾፌሩ ስምና የታርጋ ቁጥር በመተግበሪያው ላይ ከሚታየው ጋር እንደሚመሳሰል ያረጋግጡ።
om: Osoo hin seenin maqaan fi lakkoofsi dirree konkolaachisaa appii keessatti agarsiifame wajjin walsimu mirkaneessi.
ti: ቅድሚ ምእታውካ ስምን ቁጽሪ ሰሌዳን ሾፌር ምስቲ ኣብ ኣፕ ዝርአ ከም ዝሰማማዕ ኣረጋግጽ።
so: Hubi in magaca iyo lambarka taarikada darawalku ku haboon yihiin kuwa app-ka ka hor intaadan gelin.

English: No connection — your fare and distance are still being tracked, this will update the moment you're back online.
am: ግንኙነት የለም — ክፍያዎና ርቀትዎ አሁንም እየተመዘገበ ነው፣ መስመር ላይ ሲመለሱ ወዲያውኑ ይታደሳል።
om: Walitti hidhamiinsi hin jiru — kaffaltii fi fageenyi kee ammallee hordofamaa jira, yeroo toora irratti deebitu haaromfama.
ti: ርክብ የለን — ዋጋን ርሕቀትን ክሳብ ሕጂ ይኽታተል ኣሎ፣ ኣብ መስመር ምስ ተመለስካ ይሕደስ።
so: Xidhiidh ma jiro — qiimahaaga iyo masaafadaada weli waa la raacayaa, wuuna cusboonaan doonaa marka aad online noqoto.

English: A driver will link you directly — no booking needed
om: Konkolaachisaan kallattiin si walitti hidha — qabsiisuun hin barbaachisu
so: Darawal ayaa si toos ah kuu xidhi doona — dalbasho looma baahna

English: 1. Find an ETEL driver on the street
so: 1. Ka raadi darawal ETEL ah wadada

English: 2. Give them your name or phone number
om: 2. Maqaa kee yookaan lakkoofsa bilbilaa kee kenniif

English: 3. The driver links your phone — the ride appears here automatically
am: 3. ሾፌሩ ስልክዎን ያገናኛል — ጉዞው እዚህ በራስ-ሰር ይታያል
om: 3. Konkolaachisaan bilbila kee walitti hidha — imalli asitti ofumaan mul'ata
ti: 3. ሾፌር ተሌፎንካ የተሓሕዞ — እቲ ጉዕዞ ኣብዚ ባዕሉ ይርአ
so: 3. Darawalku wuu xidhaa taleefankaaga — safarku halkan ayuu isu muuqdaa

English: 4. Track your trip and pay at the end
so: 4. La soco safarkaaga oo bixi dhammaadka

ti: እዚ ገጽ ነፍሲ ወከፍ 5 ካልኢት ይምርምር
so: Bogga waxa uu hubiyaa 5 ilbiriqsi kasta

English: If a driver links your ride, you will be taken to the active ride screen automatically
am: ሾፌር ጉዞዎን ካገናኘ በራስ-ሰር ወደ ንቁ የጉዞ ገጽ ይወሰዳሉ
om: Konkolaachisaan imala kee yoo walitti hidhe, ofumaan gara fuula imala hojiirra jirutti geeffamta
ti: ሾፌር ጉዕዞኻ እንተ ኣተሓሒዙ ብባዕሉ ናብ ገጽ ንጡፍ ጉዕዞ ክትከይድ ኢኻ
so: Haddii darawal xidho safarkaaga, si toos ah ayaa laguu geynayaa shaashadda safarka firfircoon

English: Share your trip, check-ins, SOS contacts
om: Imala kee, ilaalcha, quunnamtii SOS qoodi

English: A code from your phone when you sign in
om: Yeroo seentu koodii bilbila keetii irraa
so: Koodh taleefankaaga ah marka aad gasho

om: Barruu, mallattoowwan, qabduuwwan fi mallattoo daldalaa

English: Faster, and opens even with a weak connection
am: ፈጣን ነው፣ ደካማ ግንኙነት ቢኖርም ይከፈታል
om: Ariifataa, walitti hidhamiinsa dadhabaadhaan illee banama
ti: ቅልጡፍ ኣብ ድኹም ርክብ እውን ይኽፈት
so: Degdeg ah, wuuna furmaa xitaa xidhiidh daciif ah

English: Clear cache and reload if things look stuck or old
am: የተጣበቀ ወይም የቆየ መስሎ ከታየ ካሼ ያጽዱና እንደገና ይጫኑ
om: Wanti yoo dhaabbate yookaan moofaa fakkaate cache qulqulleessiitii irra deebi'ii fe'i
ti: ነገራት እንተ ደው በሉ ወይ ሓሮጊት እንተ መሲሎም ካሽ ኣጽሪ ደጊምካ ጸዓን
so: Nadiifi cache oo dib u rar haddii wax xayiran ama duug ah ay u muuqdaan

English: Save trips you take often for one-tap rebooking.
am: ብዙ ጊዜ የሚሄዱባቸውን ጉዞዎች በአንድ ንክኪ እንደገና ለማዘዝ ያስቀምጡ።
om: Imaloota yeroo baay'ee deemtu olkaa'i, tuqaan tokkoon irra deebi'ii qabsiisuuf.
ti: ብዙሕ ግዜ እትገብሮም ጉዕዞታት ዓቅብ ብሓደ ተንኳሕ ደጊምካ ንምምዝጋብ።
so: Keydi safarrada aad badan tagto si aad mar kale ugu dalbato hal taabasho.

English: Ride updates and past support conversations.
om: Haaromsa imalaa fi haasaa deeggarsaa darban.
so: Cusbooneysiinta safarka iyo sheekaysiyadii taageerada ee hore.
Digniin ayaa loo diray taageerada ETEL

English: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" to install
am: አጋራን ይንኩ፣ ከዚያ ለመጫን "ወደ መነሻ ገጽ አክል" ን ይምረጡ
om: Qoodi tuqi, achiis "Mana Screen'tti dabali" jedhu fe'uuf
ti: ኣካፍል ተንክፍ ድሕሪኡ "ናብ ዋና ስክሪን ወስኽ" ንምጽዓን
so: Taabo Wadaag, kadibna "Ku dar Home Screen" si aad u rakibto

English: Install isn’t available yet - try again in a moment
am: መጫን እስካሁን አይቻልም - ከጥቂት ቆይታ በኋላ እንደገና ይሞክሩ
om: Fe'uun ammallee hin jiru - yeroo muraasa booda irra deebi'ii yaali
ti: ምጽዓን ሕጂ ኣይርከብን - ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደጊምካ ፈትን
so: Rakibiddu weli ma diyaarin - mar kale isku day wax yar kadib

English: App installed — find it on your home screen
am: መተግበሪያው ተጭኗል — በመነሻ ገጽዎ ላይ ያገኙታል
om: Appiin fe'ameera — screen mana keetii irratti argadhu
ti: ኣፕ ተጸዊዑ — ኣብ ዋና ስክሪንካ ርኸቦ
so: App-ka waa la rakibay — ka hel shaashaddaada hore

English: Still waiting for Chapa to confirm. It will update automatically.
am: ቻፓ እስኪያረጋግጥ አሁንም በመጠበቅ ላይ። በራስ-ሰር ይዘምናል።
om: Ammallee Chapa mirkaneessuu eegaa jira. Ofumaan haaromfama.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ Chapa ክኣምን ይጽበ ኣሎ። ባዕሉ ይሕደስ።
so: Weli waxaa la sugayaa Chapa inuu xaqiijiyo. Si toos ah ayuu isu cusbooneysiinayaa.

English: The total above is already after your promo.
am: ከላይ ያለው ድምር የማስተዋወቂያ ቅናሹ ከተቀነሰ በኋላ ነው።
om: Waliigalli olii kun duraan promo kee booda.
ti: እቲ ላዕሊ ዘሎ ጠቕላላ ድሮ ድሕሪ ፕሮሞኻ እዩ።
so: Wadarta kore waa horeyba kadib dallacaaddaada.

English: The promo discount was paid by Etel.
Drivers can accept your price or suggest another.
am: አሽከርካሪዎች ዋጋዎን ሊቀበሉ ወይም ሌላ ዋጋ ሊጠቁሙ ይችላሉ።
om: Konkolaachisoonni gatii kee fudhachuu yookaan kan biraa gaafachuu danda'u.
ti: ሾፌራት ዋጋኻ ክቕበሉ ወይ ካልእ ክጥቅሱ ይኽእሉ።
so: Darawalladu way aqbali karaan qiimahaaga ama soo jeedin kale.

English: The price is fixed once you choose a driver.
so: Qiimuhu waa go'an yahay marka aad doorato darawal.

English: That promo code is not valid
That promo code has not started yet
om: Koodiin promo sun ammallee hin jalqabne
ti: እቲ ኮድ ፕሮሞ ክሳብ ሕጂ ኣይጀመረን

om: Koodiin promo sun yeroon isaa darbeera

English: That promo code has been used up
so: Koodhkaas dallacaaddu waa la isticmaalay oo dhamaaday

English: You have already used that promo code
am: ይህን የማስተዋወቂያ ኮድ ቀደም ብለው ተጠቅመዋል
so: Horey ayaad u isticmaashay koodhkaas dallacaadda

English: Could not check the code. Try again.
om: Koodii ilaaluu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi'ii yaali.
ti: ነቲ ኮድ ክምርምሮ ኣይተኻእለን። ደጊምካ ፈትን።
so: Koodhka lama hubin karin. Mar kale isku day.

English: Make a code for riders to use. It works after an admin approves it. Etel pays for the discount.
am: ለተሳፋሪዎች የሚሆን ኮድ ይፍጠሩ። አስተዳዳሪ ካጸደቀው በኋላ ይሰራል። ቅናሹን የሚከፍለው ኢትኤል ነው።
om: Koodii imaltootaaf fayyadamuuf hojjedhu. Admin erga mirkaneesse booda hojjeta. Hir'ina Etel'n kaffala.
ti: ንተጓዓዝቲ ዝጥቀምሉ ኮድ ግበር። ኣስተዳዳሪ ድሕሪ ምጽዳቕ ይሰርሕ። ንቅናሽ ኢትኤል ይኸፍል።
so: Samee koodh rakaabku isticmaalo. Wuxuu shaqeynayaa kadib marka admin ogolaado. Etel ayaa bixisa dhimista.

English: Sent for approval. It works once an admin approves it.
om: Mirkaneessaaf ergameera. Admin yoo mirkaneesse hojjeta.
ti: ንምጽዳቕ ተሰዲዱ። ኣስተዳዳሪ ምስ ኣጽደቖ ይሰርሕ።
so: Waa loo diray ogolaansho. Wuxuu shaqeynayaa marka admin ogolaado.

English: Could not send the code. Try again.
om: Koodii ergu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi'ii yaali.
ti: ነቲ ኮድ ክሰድዶ ኣይተኻእለን። ደጊምካ ፈትን።
so: Koodhka lama dirin karin. Mar kale isku day.

English: Code must be 3-20 letters or numbers
am: ኮዱ ከ3-20 ፊደላት ወይም ቁጥሮች መሆን አለበት
om: Koodiin qubee yookaan lakkoofsa 3-20 ta'uu qaba
ti: ኮድ 3-20 ፊደላት ወይ ቁጽርታት ክኸውን ኣለዎ
so: Koodhku waa inuu noqdo 3-20 xaraf ama lambar

English: That code already exists - pick another
am: ይህ ኮድ አስቀድሞ አለ - ሌላ ይምረጡ
om: Koodiin sun duraan jira - kan biraa filadhu
ti: እቲ ኮድ ድሮ ኣሎ - ካልእ ምረጽ
so: Koodhkaas horey ayuu u jiray - dooro mid kale

English: 1. Send it to one of these accounts
so: 1. U dir mid ka mid ah koontooyinkan

English: Or send it by bank transfer
Could not open Chapa. Try again.
om: Chapa banuu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi'ii yaali.
so: Chapa lama furi karin. Mar kale isku day.

English: Your driver gets all of it, after Etel confirms your transfer.
am: ሾፌርዎ ሙሉውን ያገኛል፣ ኢትኤል ዝውውርዎን ካረጋገጠ በኋላ።
om: Konkolaachisaan kee hunda argata, Etel dabarsa kee erga mirkaneessee booda.
ti: ሾፌርካ ኩሉ ይረክብ፣ ኢትኤል ምስግጋርካ ምስ ኣረጋገጸ።
so: Darawalkaagu wuu helayaa dhammaantiis, kadib marka Etel xaqiijiso wareejintaada.

English: Etel has not set up a bank account for tips yet.
am: ኢትኤል ለሽልማት የባንክ አካውንት እስካሁን አላዘጋጀም።
om: Etel ammallee herrega baankii kennaa hin qopheessine.
ti: ኢትኤል ክሳብ ሕጂ ንጉርሻ ሒሳብ ባንክ ኣይመቐሎን።
so: Etel weli ma dejin koonto bangi oo tibaaxaha ah.

English: Choose an amount of at least ETB 5
Enter the transfer reference from your bank
om: Lakkoofsa wabii dabarsaa baankii kee irraa galchi
ti: ቁጽሪ ርእይቶ ምስግጋር ካብ ባንክካ የእትው

English: Could not send the tip. Try again.
om: Kennaa ergu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi'ii yaali.
so: Tibaaxda lama dirin karin. Mar kale isku day.

English: Thank you! The tip reaches your driver once Etel confirms the transfer.
am: እናመሰግናለን! ኢትኤል ዝውውሩን ካረጋገጠ በኋላ ሽልማቱ ሾፌርዎ ጋር ይደርሳል።
om: Galatoomi! Kennaan konkolaachisaa kee ni gahaa Etel dabarsa erga mirkaneessee booda.
ti: የቐንየልና! ጉርሻ ኢትኤል ምስግጋር ምስ ኣረጋገጸ ንሾፌርካ ይበጽሕ።
so: Mahadsanid! Tibaaxdu waxay gaadhaysaa darawalkaaga marka Etel xaqiijiso wareejinta.

English: Waiting for Etel to confirm your transfer
om: Etel dabarsa kee mirkaneessuu eegaa jira
so: Waxaa la sugayaa Etel inuu xaqiijiyo wareejintaada

English: Sent to your driver. Thank you!
Etel could not find the transfer
No completed trip to tip for yet.
om: Imalli tippii kennuuf xumurame hin jiru.
so: Weli safar dhamaaday oo tibaax loo bixiyo ma jiro.

English: You can tip once the trip is completed
om: Imalli erga xumuramee booda kennuu dandeessa
ti: ጉዕዞ ምስ ተወድአ ጉርሻ ክትህብ ትኽእል
so: Waad tibaaxi kartaa marka safarku dhammaado

English: It is too late to tip for this trip

om: Imala imaltichi xumure — ammas argamtee jirta

English: Each tip is added to your cash-out balance in full, with no commission, once Etel confirms the rider's transfer.
am: እያንዳንዱ ሽልማት ኢትኤል የተሳፋሪውን ዝውውር ካረጋገጠ በኋላ ያለ ኮሚሽን ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ገንዘብ ማውጫ ቀሪ ሂሳብዎ ይጨመራል።
om: Kennaan hunduu hanga baasuu keetitti guutuutti dabalama, komishinii malee, Etel dabarsa imaltichaa erga mirkaneessee booda.
ti: ነፍሲ ወከፍ ጉርሻ ኢትኤል ምስግጋር ተጓዓዚ ምስ ኣረጋገጸ ብምሉኡ ብዘይ ኮሚሽን ናብ ሂሳብ ምውጻእካ ይወሰኽ።
so: Tibaax kasta waxaa lagu daraa hadhaagaaga la bixin karo si buuxda, la'aan komishin, kadib marka Etel xaqiijiso wareejinta rakaabka.

English: Promo discounts are paid by Etel: when a rider uses a promo code, the discount is added to your ኢE Money balance.
am: የማስተዋወቂያ ቅናሽ የሚከፍለው ኢትኤል ነው፦ ተሳፋሪ የማስተዋወቂያ ኮድ ሲጠቀም ቅናሹ ወደ ኢE ገንዘብ ቀሪ ሂሳብዎ ይጨመራል።
om: Hir'ina promo'n Etel'n kaffalama: imaltichi koodii promo yoo fayyadame, hir'inni hanga Maallaqa Etel kee irratti dabalama.
ti: ቅናሽ ፕሮሞ ብኢትኤል ይኽፈል፦ ተጓዓዚ ኮድ ፕሮሞ ምስ ተጠቐመ እቲ ቅናሽ ናብ ሂሳብ ገንዘብ ኢE ይወሰኽ።
so: Dhimista dallacaadda waxaa bixiya Etel: marka rakaab isticmaalo koodh dallacaad, dhimistu waxay ku dhacdaa hadhaagaaga Lacagta Etel.

English: Etel collected this fare for you.
You collected this fare in cash.
so: Qiimahan waxaad ku uruurisay lacag caddaan.

English: Etel takes 5% of each fare, including the part a promo code paid. Tips are yours in full.
am: ኢትኤል ከእያንዳንዱ ክፍያ 5% ይወስዳል፣ በማስተዋወቂያ ኮድ የተከፈለውንም ጨምሮ። ሽልማት ሙሉ በሙሉ የእርስዎ ነው።
om: Etel kaffaltii hunda irraa 5% fudhata, kutaa koodii promo kaffale dabalatee. Kennaan guutuutti kan kee.
ti: ኢትኤል ካብ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ዋጋ 5% ይወስድ፣ እቲ ኮድ ፕሮሞ ዝኸፈሎ ክፋል ጨምሮ። ጉርሻ ብምሉኡ ናትካ እዩ።
so: Etel wuxuu qaataa 5% qiime kasta, oo ay ku jirto qaybta dallacaaddu bixisay. Tibaaxuhu gebi ahaanba waa kuwaaga.

English: Or slide the request to accept the rider's price.

English: The rider used a promo code. Collect the amount shown. Etel pays the discount: it is added to your Etel money balance.

om: Imaltichi koodii promo fayyadameera. Hanga agarsiifame sassaabi. Etel hir'ina kaffala: hanga maallaqa Etel keetitti dabalama.
ti: ተጓዓዚ ኮድ ፕሮሞ ተጠቒሙ። እቲ ዝተርኣየ መጠን ኣኪብ። ኢትኤል ንቅናሽ ይኸፍል፦ ናብ ሂሳብ ገንዘብ ኢትኤል ይወሰኽ።

English: The promo discount was paid by Etel. Your earnings are not reduced.
am: የማስተዋወቂያ ቅናሹን የከፈለው ኢትኤል ነው። ገቢዎ አይቀንስም።
om: Hir'ina promo'n Etel'n kaffame. Galiin kee hin hir'anne.

om: Koodii kee fe'uu hin dandeenye — yeroo muraasa booda irra deebi'ii yaali.

am: ተቀባዩ ባለ 4 አሃዝ ፒኑን ይነግርዎታል። መቀበላቸውን ያረጋግጣል።

English: The sender shows the 4-digit PIN in their app. It confirms you have the right package.
am: ላኪው ባለ 4 አሃዝ ፒኑን በመተግበሪያው ያሳይዎታል። ትክክለኛውን ጥቅል መውሰድዎን ያረጋግጣል።

ti: ሰዳዲ PIN ባዕለ 4 ቁጽሪ ኣብ ኣፕኦም የርኢ። ቅኑዕ ጥቅል ከም ዘለካ የረጋግጽ።

am: ከመስመር ይውጡ? ለአዳዲስ አቅርቦቶች ዝግጁ ሆነው መታየት ያቆማሉ።

am: ሥራው ተቀባይነት አግኝቷል! ወደ "ንቁ" ትር ይሂዱ።
om: Hojiin fudhatameera! Gara Tab Hojiirra jiruutti deemi.

English: Job accepted! Head to the shop.

so: Shaqo waa la aqbalay! U gudub dukaanka.

om: Kaartaan hin qophoofne — irra deebi'ii yaali
so: Khariidadda diyaar ma aha — mar kale isku day

English: Map not ready — try again in a moment
am: ካርታው ዝግጁ አይደለም — ትንሽ ቆይተው ይሞክሩ
om: Kaartaan hin qophoofne — yeroo muraasa booda irra deebi'ii yaali
ti: ካርታ ድሉው ኣይኮነን — ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደጊምካ ፈትን
so: Khariidadda diyaar ma aha — mar kale isku day wax yar kadib

English: Map not ready. Try again in a moment.
am: ካርታው ዝግጁ አይደለም። ትንሽ ቆይተው ይሞክሩ።
om: Kaartaan hin qophoofne. Yeroo muraasa booda irra deebi'ii yaali.
ti: ካርታ ድሉው ኣይኮነን። ድሕሪ ቁሩብ ደጊምካ ፈትን።
so: Khariidadda diyaar ma aha. Mar kale isku day wax yar kadib.

English: New job offer - accept it before the timer runs out
am: አዲስ የሥራ ጥያቄ - ጊዜው ሳያልቅ ይቀበሉ
om: Dhiyeessii hojii haaraa - yeroon osoo hin xumuramin fudhadhu
ti: ሓድሽ ጥቕሚ ስራሕ - ሰዓት ቅድሚ ዝውዳእ ተቐበሎ
so: Soo jeedin shaqo cusub - aqbal ka hor inta waqtigu dhamaan

English: Request sent! Waiting for customer to confirm…
am: ጥያቄ ተልኳል! ደንበኛው እስኪያረጋግጥ በመጠበቅ ላይ…
om: Gaaffiin ergameera! Maamilli mirkaneessuu eegaa jira…
ti: ሕቶ ተሰዲዱ! ዓሚል ክኣምን ይጽበ ኣሎ…
so: Codsiga waa la diray! Sugitaanka macmiilka inuu xaqiijiyo…

English: Request sent! Waiting for service giver to confirm…
am: ጥያቄ ተልኳል! አገልግሎት ሰጪው እስኪያረጋግጥ በመጠበቅ ላይ…
om: Gaaffiin ergameera! Tajaajila kennaan mirkaneessuu eegaa jira…
ti: ሕቶ ተሰዲዱ! ኣገልጋሊ ክኣምን ይጽበ ኣሎ…
so: Codsiga waa la diray! Sugitaanka bixiyaha adeegga inuu xaqiijiyo…

English: ✅ Pickup confirmed by service giver! Order is now in transit.
am: ✅ አገልግሎት ሰጪው መረከቡን አረጋግጧል! ትዕዛዙ አሁን በጉዞ ላይ ነው።
om: ✅ Fudhachuun tajaajila kennaan mirkanaa'eera! Ajajni amma karaa irra jira.
ti: ✅ ምቕባል ብኣገልጋሊ ተረጋጊጹ! ትእዛዝ ሕጂ ኣብ መገዲ እዩ።
so: ✅ Qaadashada waxaa xaqiijiyay bixiyaha adeegga! Dalabku hadda waa socdaa.

English: 🎉 Delivery confirmed by customer! Great job!
so: 🎉 Gaarsiinta waxaa xaqiijiyay macmiilka! Shaqo wanaagsan!

am: ✅ ዝግጅት ተጠናቅቋል — ሹፌሩን እና ደንበኛውን አሳውቅ
so: ✅ Diyaarinta waa dhammaatay — Ogeysii Gaarsiiyaha iyo Macmiilka

English: The customer is told right away and gets their money back if they already paid. Pick the reason.
am: ደንበኛው ወዲያውኑ ይነገረዋል፤ ቀድሞ ከከፈለም ገንዘቡ ይመለስለታል። ምክንያቱን ይምረጡ።
om: Maamilli battalumatti beeksifama, yoo duraan kaffale maallaqni isaa deebi'a. Sababa filadhu.
ti: ዓሚል ብቕጽበት ይፍለጥ፣ ድሮ ዝኸፈለ እንተኾነ ገንዘቡ ይምለስ። ምኽንያት ምረጽ።
so: Macmiilka isla markiiba ayaa la ogeysiiyaa, wuxuuna helaa lacagtiisa haddii uu horey u bixiyay. Dooro sababta.

om: ○ Toora irraa ba'e — toora irratti ba'uuf tuqi
ti: ○ ካብ መስመር ወጺኡ — ናብ መስመር ንምእታው ተንክፍ
so: ○ Offline — taabo si aad u noqoto online
jawaab si aad u dhisto kalsooni

English: No reviews yet. They appear here after customers rate delivered orders.
am: እስካሁን ግምገማ የለም። ደንበኞች የደረሱ ትዕዛዞችን ደረጃ ሲሰጡ እዚህ ይታያሉ።
om: Ilaalchi hin jiru. Maamiltoonni ajajoota geessame erga madaalan booda as mul'atu.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ግምገማ የለን። ዓማዊል ዝቐረቡ ትእዛዛት ምስ ገምገሙ ኣብዚ ይርአ።
so: Weli dib u eegis ma jiro. Waxay halkan ka muuqdaan kadib marka macaamiishu qiimeeyaan dalabyada la gaarsiiyay.

English: Best size 1200 × 600 (2:1), JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB. Saved with "Save" below.
am: ተመራጭ መጠን 1200 × 600 (2:1)፣ JPG ወይም PNG፣ እስከ 5 ሜባ። ከታች "አስቀምጥ" ሲጫኑ ይቀመጣል።

English: Square logo images print best on kitchen tickets — tap the camera icon above to change it.
am: ካሬ ቅርጽ ያላቸው አርማዎች በኩሽና ትኬት ላይ በደንብ ይታተማሉ — ለመቀየር ከላይ ያለውን የካሜራ ምልክት ይንኩ።

English: How this business gets paid out. Fill in whichever methods you actually use — you don't need all of them.
am: ይህ ንግድ ክፍያውን እንዴት እንደሚቀበል። የሚጠቀሙባቸውን መንገዶች ብቻ ይሙሉ — ሁሉንም መሙላት አያስፈልግም።
om: Daldalli kun akkamitti akka kaffalamu. Mala dhugaa fayyadamtan qofa guuti — hunda barbaachisu hin qabdan.
ti: እዚ ንግዲ ከመይ ከም ዝኸፈል። እቲ ብሓቂ እትጥቀመሉ ጥራይ መልእ — ኩሉ ኣየድልን።
so: Sida ganacsigani lacagta u helo. Buuxi habka aad dhab ahaan u isticmaasho — uma baahnid dhammaan.

English: (optional — shown to customers who switch the app to Amharic)
am: (አማራጭ — መተግበሪያውን ወደ አማርኛ ለሚቀይሩ ደንበኞች ይታያል)

English: Customers can only order inside these hours. Leave empty to be open whenever your switch is on.
am: ደንበኞች በእነዚህ ሰዓቶች ውስጥ ብቻ ማዘዝ ይችላሉ። ማብሪያው በበራ ጊዜ ሁሉ ክፍት ለመሆን ባዶ ይተዉት።
om: Maamiltoonni sa'aatii kana keessatti qofa ajajuu danda'u. Yeroo furtuun kee banaa ta'e hunda banaa ta'uuf duwwaa dhiisi.
ti: ዓማዊል ኣብዞም ሰዓታት ጥራይ ከዝዝሙ ይኽእሉ። መቐያየሪኻ ክሳብ ዝተኸፍተ ክፉት ንኽኸውን ባዶ ሕደግ።
so: Macaamiishu way dalban karaan saacadahan gudahood oo keliya. Iska daa si aad u furnaato mar kasta oo furahaagu shidan yahay.

English: Tick the dishes you sell and type your own price. Names, Amharic names and descriptions are filled in for you.
am: የሚሸጧቸውን ምግቦች ይምረጡ እና የራስዎን ዋጋ ይጻፉ። ስሞች፣ የአማርኛ ስሞች እና መግለጫዎች በራስ-ሰር ይሞላሉ።
om: Nyaata ati gurguru mallattoo godhi, gatii kee mataa kee barreessi. Maqaan, maqaan Amaaraa fi ibsi siif guutama.
ti: እተሸይጦም ኣብሊዕ ምልክት ግበር፣ ናይ ባዕልኻ ዋጋ ጽሓፍ። ስማት፣ ስማት ኣምሓርኛን መግለጺታትን ይመልኡልካ።
so: Calaamadee cuntooyinka aad iibiso oo qor qiimahaaga. Magacyada, magacyada Amxaariga iyo sharaxaadda ayaa lagaaga buuxiyay.

English: Connect your Bluetooth kitchen printer once here. After that, "Start Preparing" and "Reprint Kitchen Ticket" print directly to it - branded with your own business name, no third-party app or ads.
am: የብሉቱዝ የኩሽና ፕሪንተርዎን እዚህ አንድ ጊዜ ያገናኙ። ከዚያ በኋላ "ዝግጅት ጀምር" እና "የኩሽና ትኬት እንደገና አትም" በቀጥታ ወደ እሱ ያትማሉ - በራስዎ የንግድ ስም፣ ያለ ሶስተኛ ወገን መተግበሪያ ወይም ማስታወቂያ።
om: Maxxansaa ukkaamsaa Bluetooth kee al tokko as walitti hidhi. Achiin booda, "Qopheessuu jalqabi" fi "Tikeeta irra deebi'ii maxxansi" kallattiin isatti maxxanfama - maqaa daldala kee mataa keetiin, appii nama biraa yookaan beeksisa malee.
ti: ሓታሚ ክሽነ Bluetooth ሓንሳ ኣብዚ ኣተሓሕዞ። ድሕሪኡ "ምድላው ጀምር" ከምኡ "ትኬት ክሽነ ደጊምካ ሓትም" ቀጥታ ናብኡ ይሓትም - ብስም ንግድኻ፣ ብዘይ ካልእ ኣፕ ወይ ሕታም።
so: Ku xidh daabacahaaga jikada ee Bluetooth hal mar halkan. Kadib, "Bilow diyaarinta" iyo "Dib u daabac tikidhka jikada" waxay toos ugu daabacayaan - magaca ganacsigaaga ku qoran, app dhinac saddexaad ama xayeysiis la'aan.

English: Enter both an opening and a closing time, or press Clear
am: የመክፈቻ እና የመዝጊያ ሰዓት ሁለቱንም ያስገቡ፣ ወይም "አጽዳ" ይጫኑ
om: Yeroo banuu fi cufuu lamaanuu galchi, yookaan Qulqulleessi tuqi
ti: ክልቲኡ ግዜ ምኽፋትን ምዕጻውን የእትው ወይ ኣጽሪ ተንክፍ
so: Geli labadaba waqtiga furitaanka iyo xidhitaanka, ama taabo Nadiifi

English: Opening hours cleared - you are open whenever your switch is on
am: የሥራ ሰዓት ጸድቷል - ማብሪያው በበራ ጊዜ ሁሉ ክፍት ነዎት
om: Sa'aatiin banaa qulqullaa'eera - furtuun kee banaa yoo ta'e yeroo hundaa banaadha
ti: ሰዓታት ምኽፋት ተጸሪዩ - መቐያየሪኻ ክሳብ ዝተኸፍተ ክፉት ኢኻ
so: Saacadaha furitaanka waa la nadiifiyay - waad furan tahay mar kasta oo furahaagu shidan yahay

English: Open and closed follow your opening hours ({a} to {b}). Change the hours in the box below.
am: ክፍት እና ዝግ በሥራ ሰዓትዎ ይወሰናል ({a} እስከ {b})። ሰዓቱን ከታች ባለው ሳጥን ይቀይሩ።

English: Delete this role? Staff currently assigned to it will fall back to view-only access.
am: ይህ ሚና ይሰረዝ? በዚህ ሚና ላይ ያሉ ሠራተኞች ለማየት ብቻ ወደሚፈቅድ መዳረሻ ይመለሳሉ።
om: Gahee kana haquu? Hojjettoonni amma itti ramadaman ilaaluu qofatti deebi'u.
ti: እዚ ሚና ክሰርዝ ድዩ? ሕጂ ዝተመደቡ ሰራሕተኛታት ናብ ምርኣይ ጥራይ ይምለሱ።
so: Ma tirtiraa doorkan? Shaqaalaha hadda loo qoondeeyay waxay ku noqonayaan aragti oo keliya.

English: No custom roles yet - define one below, then assign it to staff.
am: እስካሁን የራስዎ ሚና የለም - ከታች አንዱን ይወስኑ፣ ከዚያ ለሠራተኞች ይመድቡ።
om: Ammallee gahee addaa hin jiru - kan gadii ibsi, achiis hojjettootatti ramadi.
ti: ክሳብ ሕጂ ፍሉይ ሚና የለን - ኣብ ታሕቲ ኣወሓሕድ ድሕሪኡ ንሰራሕተኛታት መድብ።
so: Weli doorar gaar ah ma jiraan - qeex mid hoose, kadib u qoondee shaqaalaha.

om: EtelID jiru akka hojjettootaatti walitti hidhameera!
so: EtelID jira ayaa loogu xidhay shaqaale!
Koonto shaqaale cusub ayaa la sameeyay!

English: Direct printing needs Chrome on Android or desktop.
am: ቀጥታ ማተም Chrome በአንድሮይድ ወይም በኮምፒውተር ላይ ይፈልጋል።
om: Maxxansuun kallattii Chrome Android yookaan desktop irratti barbaada.
ti: ቀጥታ ሕታም ኣብ ኣንድሮይድ ወይ ዴስክቶፕ Chrome የድሊ።
so: Daabacaadda toos ah waxay u baahan tahay Chrome Android ama desktop.

English: Printer forgotten. Connect again to pair.
om: Maxxansaan irraanfatameera. Walitti hidhuuf irra deebi'ii hidhi.
so: Daabacaha waa la iloobay. Mar kale ku xidh si aad isugu xidho.
Calaamadee cuntooyin si aad u darto

English: Add a wide photo of your shop or best dish. Customers see it on your card in the ETEL app.
am: የሱቅዎን ወይም ምርጥ ምግብዎን ሰፊ ፎቶ ያክሉ። ደንበኞች በETEL መተግበሪያ ውስጥ በካርድዎ ላይ ያዩታል።
om: Suuraa bal'aa suuqaa kee yookaan nyaata gaarii dabali. Maamiltoonni kaardii kee irratti appii ETEL keessatti argu.
ti: ሰፊሕ ፎቶ ድኳንካ ወይ ዝበለጸ ኣብሊዕ ወስኽ። ዓማዊል ኣብ ካርድካ ኣብ ኣፕ ETEL ይርእይዎ።
so: Ku dar sawir ballaaran oo dukaankaaga ama cuntadaada ugu wanaagsan. Macaamiishu waxay ku arkaan kaarkaaga app-ka ETEL.

English: ✦ Recommended — One ID for all ETEL services ✦
am: ✦ የሚመከር — ለሁሉም ETEL አገልግሎቶች አንድ መታወቂያ ✦

English: Sign in to continue to your
so: Gal si aad ugu sii socoto

English: Manage Etel Group staff, roles, and operations.
am: የኤቴል ግሩፕ ሰራተኞችን፣ ሚናዎችን እና ስራዎችን ያስተዳድሩ።
om: Hojjettoota Gareen Etel, gahee fi hojii bulchi.
ti: ሰራሕተኛታት ጉጅለ ኢትኤል፣ ሚናታትን ስራሕታትን ኣመሓድር።
so: Maamul shaqaalaha Kooxda Etel, doorarka iyo hawlgallada.

om: Fuulli itti bu'uu gahee EtelGroup kee irratti hundaa'a
so: Bogga ku dhacaa wuxuu ku xiran yahay doorkaaga EtelGroup

English: Send money to your wallet number via Telebirr or bank transfer. Contact support after sending to credit your account.
am: ገንዘብ ወደ ዋሌት ቁጥርዎ በቴሌብር ወይም በባንክ ይላኩ። ከላኩ በኋላ ሂሳብዎ እንዲሞላ ድጋፍን ያነጋግሩ።
om: Maallaqa lakkoofsa Waalet keetii irratti Telebirr yookaan baankiin ergi. Erguun booda akka herregni kee guutamu deeggarsa quunnami.
ti: ገንዘብ ናብ ቁጽሪ ዋሌትካ ብቴሌብር ወይ ብባንክ ስደድ። ምስ ሰዳኻ ሂሳብካ ክመልእ ደገፍ ተወከስ።
so: Lacagta u dir lambarka wallet-kaaga Telebirr ama bangi. Markaad dirto kadib la xidhiidh taageerada si koontadaada loo buuxiyo.

English: Pay online: Telebirr, CBE Birr, banks, cards
am: በመስመር ላይ ይክፈሉ፦ ቴሌብር፣ ሲቢኢ ብር፣ ባንኮች፣ ካርዶች
om: Toora interneetii irratti kaffali: Telebirr, CBE Birr, baankota, kaardii
ti: ኣብ መስመር ክፈል፦ ቴሌብር፣ ሲቢኢ ብር፣ ባንኪታት፣ ካርድታት
so: Ku bixi online: Telebirr, CBE Birr, bangiyo, kaararka

English: Cash or in-person to an admin
om: Maallaqa harkaa yookaan fuullee-fuullee admin tti
so: Lacag caddaan ah ama gacan ka gacan admin-ka

English: Tap to copy · Use this exact reference when paying
am: ለመቅዳት ይንኩ · ሲከፍሉ ይህንኑ ማጣቀሻ ይጠቀሙ
om: Garagalchuuf tuqi · Yeroo kaffaltu lakkoofsa kana sirriitti fayyadami
ti: ንምቕዳሕ ተንክፍ · ክትኸፍል ከለኻ እዚ ሓቲ ቁጽሪ ተጠቐም
so: Taabo si aad u koobiyayso · Marka aad bixinayso isticmaal tixraacan saxda ah

English: We received your confirmation and will credit your wallet within minutes. You'll see the balance update automatically.
am: ማረጋገጫዎን ተቀብለናል፤ በደቂቃዎች ውስጥ ዋሌትዎ ይሞላል። ቀሪ ሂሳቡ በራሱ ይታደሳል።
om: Mirkaneessa kee fudhanneerra; daqiiqaa muraasa keessatti Waalet kee ni guutama. Hanga ofumaan haaromsama.
ti: መረጋገጺኻ ተቐቢልናዮ፤ ኣብ ውሽጢ ደቓይቕ ዋሌትካ ክመልእ እዩ። ሂሳብ ባዕሉ ይሓድስ።
so: Xaqiijintaada waan helnay; daqiiqado gudahood ayaa wallet-kaaga la buuxin doonaa. Hadhaaggu si toos ah ayuu isu cusbooneysiinayaa.

English: Failed to load. Pull to retry.
om: Fe'uun hin danda'amne. Irra deebi'ee yaaluuf harkisi.
so: Ma soo dhacin. Jiid si aad mar kale u tijaabiso.
Soo geli ID · Fur xadka oo dhan

English: Add funds via Telebirr or bank
so: Ku dar lacag Telebirr ama bangi
Samee oo wadaag xiriiriyeyaasha lacag bixinta

English: Scan to send money to this wallet
om: Maallaqa Waalet kanaaf ergachuuf iskaan godhi
ti: ገንዘብ ናብዚ ዋሌት ንምስዳድ ስካን ግበር
so: Iskaan si aad lacag ugu dirto wallet-kan

English: Generate a QR code with a specific amount. Anyone who scans it will be prompted to pay exactly that amount.
am: የተወሰነ መጠን ያለው QR ኮድ ይፍጠሩ። የሚቃኘው ሰው ያንኑ መጠን እንዲከፍል ይጠየቃል።
om: Koodii QR hanga murtaa'e qabu uumi. Namni isa iskaan godhu hanga sana kaffaluuf gaafatama.
ti: QR ኮድ ብዝተወሰነ መጠን ፍጠር። እቲ ዝስካን ሰብ ነታ መጠን ክኸፍል ይሓተት።
so: Samee koodh QR oo qadar gaar ah leh. Qofka iskaaniya waxaa lagu weydiin doonaa inuu bixiyo qadarkaas.

English: Paste a QR token below or enter the payment code you received.
am: ከታች የQR ቶከን ይለጥፉ ወይም የተቀበሉትን የክፍያ ኮድ ያስገቡ።
om: Gadii QR token maxxansi yookaan koodii kaffaltii fudhatte galchi.
ti: ኣብ ታሕቲ QR ቶከን ለጥፍ ወይ ዝተቐበልካዮ ኮድ ክፍሊት የእትው።
so: Hoos ku dheji token QR ama geli koodhka lacag bixinta ee aad heshay.

om: Hanga (ETB) — duraan kan murtaa'e yoo ta'e duwwaa dhiisi
ti: መጠን (ብር) — ቅድም እንተ ተወሲኑ ባዶ ሕደግ
so: Qadar (ETB) — iska daa haddii horey loo qeexay

English: 💡 You need an ኢE Pay account to send this payment.
am: 💡 ይህን ክፍያ ለመላክ የኢE Pay መለያ ያስፈልግዎታል።
om: 💡 Kaffaltii kana ergachuuf akkaawuntii ETEL Pay si barbaachisa.
ti: 💡 ነዚ ክፍሊት ንምስዳድ ኣካውንት ኢE Pay የድልየካ።
so: 💡 Waxaad u baahan tahay koonto ETEL Pay si aad lacagtan u dirto.
Waa bilaash oo waxay qaadataa 30 ilbiriqsi.

English: This payment link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
am: ይህ የክፍያ ሊንክ ልክ አይደለም፣ ጊዜው አልፏል ወይም ቀድሞ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።
om: Liinkiin kaffaltii kun sirrii miti, yeroon isaa darbeera, yookaan duraan fayyadamameera.
ti: እዚ ሊንክ ክፍሊት ቅኑዕ ኣይኮነን፣ ግዜኡ ሓሊፉ ወይ ቅድም ተጠቒሙ።
so: Xiriiriyahan lacag bixinta waa khalad, wuu dhacay, ama horey ayaa loo isticmaalay.

English: Share a link · anyone can pay you instantly
am: ሊንክ ያጋሩ · ማንም ወዲያውኑ ሊከፍልዎ ይችላል
om: Liinkii qoodi · nami kamiyyuu battalumatti si kaffaluu danda'a
ti: ሊንክ ኣካፍል · ዝኾነ ሰብ ብቅጽበት ክኸፍለካ ይኽእል
so: Wadaag xiriiriye · qof kasta ayaa degdeg kuu bixin kara
Qadar (iska daa si qadar furan u noqoto)

English: Your identity is verified. All transaction limits are unlocked.
am: ማንነትዎ ተረጋግጧል። ሁሉም የግብይት ገደቦች ተከፍተዋል።
om: Eenyummaan kee mirkanaa'eera. Daangaan daldalaa hundi banameera.
ti: መንነትካ ተረጋጊጹ። ኩሉ ገደብ ግብይት ተኸፊቱ።
so: Aqoonsigaaga waa la xaqiijiyay. Xadka wareejinta oo dhan waa furan yahay.
EtelID waxay ku siinaysaa xaqiijin degdeg ah.

English: You already have an EtelID account? Connect it instantly — no document upload needed.
am: EtelID መለያ አለዎት? ወዲያውኑ ያገናኙ — ሰነድ መጫን አያስፈልግም።
om: Akkaawuntii EtelID duraan qabdaa? Battalumatti walitti hidhi — sanadni olkaa'uun hin barbaachisu.
ti: ኣካውንት EtelID ቅድሚ ሕጂ ኣለካ ድዩ? ብቅጽበት ኣተሓሕዞ — ሰነድ ምጽዓን የድልን።
so: Koonto EtelID horey ma leedahay? Isla markiiba ku xidh — uma baahnid inaad dukumeenti soo gelisid.

English: Upload your national ID, passport, or driving license for manual review (24–48hrs).
am: ብሔራዊ መታወቂያዎን፣ ፓስፖርትዎን ወይም መንጃ ፈቃድዎን ለእጅ ግምገማ ይጫኑ (24–48 ሰዓት)።
om: ID biyyaalessaa, paaspoortii yookaan hayyama konkolaachisaa ilaalcha harkaatiif olkaa'i (sa'aatii 24–48).
ti: ብሄራዊ መንነት፣ ፓስፖርት ወይ ፍቓድ መዘወሪ ንብኢድ ግምገማ ጸዓን (24–48 ሰዓታት)።
so: Soo geli aqoonsiga qaranka, baasaboorka ama shatiga darawalnimada si gacanta loogu eego (24–48 saac).
Taleefankaaga EtelID (haddii uu kala duwan yahay)

English: Leave blank to use your wallet phone number.
am: የዋሌት ስልክ ቁጥርዎን ለመጠቀም ባዶ ይተዉ።
om: Lakkoofsa bilbilaa Waalet kee fayyadamuuf duwwaa dhiisi.
ti: ቁጽሪ ተሌፎን ዋሌትካ ንምጥቃም ባዶ ሕደግ።
so: Iska daa si aad u isticmaasho lambarka taleefanka wallet-kaaga.
Soo geli dhinaca hore ee dukumeentiga

English: Tap to take photo or upload
so: Taabo si aad sawir u qaadato ama u soo gelisid

English: Hold document next to your face
Orders, couriers, shops, menus and delivery prices.
am: ትዕዛዞች፣ ተላላኪዎች፣ ሱቆች፣ ምናሌዎች እና የማድረሻ ዋጋዎች።
om: Ajajoota, geessitootaa, suuqota, menu fi gatii geessuu.
ti: ትእዛዛት፣ ኣቕራብቲ፣ ድኳናት፣ ምናሌታትን ዋጋ ምቕራብን።
so: Dalabyada, gaarsiiyeyaasha, dukaamada, menu-yada iyo qiimaha gaarsiinta.

English: Ride requests, drivers, safety and ride payments.
am: የጉዞ ጥያቄዎች፣ ሾፌሮች፣ ደህንነት እና የጉዞ ክፍያዎች።
om: Gaaffii imalaa, konkolaachisoota, nageenyaa fi kaffaltii imalaa.
ti: ሕቶ ጉዕዞ፣ ሾፌራት፣ ድሕነትን ክፍሊት ጉዕዞን።
so: Codsiyada safarka, darawallada, amniga iyo lacag bixinta safarka.

English: People, money, support and settings that both systems share.
am: ሁለቱም ሲስተሞች የሚጋሯቸው ሰዎች፣ ገንዘብ፣ ድጋፍ እና ቅንብሮች።
om: Namoota, maallaqa, deeggarsa fi qindaa'inoota sirnoonni lamaan waliin fayyadaman.
ti: ክልቲኦም ሲስተማት ዘካፍልዎም ሰባት፣ ገንዘብ፣ ደገፍን ቅጥዕታትን።
so: Dadka, lacagta, taageerada iyo dejinnada labada nidaam wadaagaan.

English: Orders that need a courier right now. Assign by hand.
am: አሁን ተላላኪ የሚፈልጉ ትዕዛዞች። በእጅ ይመድቡ።
om: Ajajoota amma geessaa barbaadan. Harkaan ramadi.
ti: ሕጂ ኣቕራቢ ዝደልዩ ትእዛዛት። ብኢድ መድብ።
so: Dalabyada hadda gaarsiiye u baahan. Ku qoondee gacan.

English: Every delivery order: search, status, details.
am: እያንዳንዱ የማድረሻ ትዕዛዝ፦ ፍለጋ፣ ሁኔታ፣ ዝርዝር።
om: Ajaja geessuu hunda: barbaaduu, haala, tarreeffama.
ti: ነፍሲ ወከፍ ትእዛዝ ምቕራብ፦ ድሌት፣ ኩነታት፣ ዝርዝር።
so: Dalab kasta oo gaarsiin: raadin, xaalad, faahfaahin.

English: Package prices by vehicle, distance and weight.
am: የጥቅል ዋጋ በተሽከርካሪ፣ ርቀት እና ክብደት።
om: Gatii ba'aa konkolaataa, fageenyaa fi ulfaatina irratti.
so: Qiimaha xirmooyinka marka loo eego baabuurka, masaafada iyo culeyska.

English: Chats between customers, shops and couriers.
am: በደንበኞች፣ ሱቆች እና ተላላኪዎች መካከል ያሉ ውይይቶች።
om: Haasaa maamiltootaa, suuqotaa fi geessitootaa gidduu.
ti: ኣብ ማእከል ዓማዊል፣ ድኳናትን ኣቕራብትን ዝኾነ ዝርርብ።
so: Sheekaysiga ka dhexeeya macaamiisha, dukaamada iyo gaarsiiyeyaasha.

English: Shops and service givers: verification and menus.
am: ሱቆች እና አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች፦ ማረጋገጫ እና ምናሌዎች።
om: Suuqotaa fi tajaajila kennitoota: mirkaneessaa fi menu.
so: Dukaamada iyo bixiyeyaasha adeegga: xaqiijin iyo menu-yo.

English: What customers said about shops and couriers.
am: ደንበኞች ስለ ሱቆች እና ተላላኪዎች የተናገሩት።
om: Wanti maamiltoonni suuqotaa fi geessitootaa irratti jedhan.
so: Wixii macaamiishu ka yidhaahdeen dukaamada iyo gaarsiiyeyaasha.

English: Products and prices in every shop.
am: በእያንዳንዱ ሱቅ ውስጥ ያሉ ምርቶች እና ዋጋዎች።
om: Oomishootaa fi gatiiwwan suuqii hunda keessa.
ti: ኣብ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ድኳን ዘለዉ ምህርቲን ዋጋታትን።

English: The shared menu catalog shops pick from.
om: Kaataloogii menu waloo suuqonni irraa filatan.
so: Buug-gacmeedka menu-ga la wadaago ee dukaamadu doortaan.

English: Delivery fees and zones, and ride fares.
am: የማድረሻ ክፍያዎች እና ዞኖች፣ እና የጉዞ ዋጋዎች።
om: Kaffaltii geessuu fi aanaalee, fi gatii imalaa.
so: Khidmadaha gaarsiinta iyo aagagga, iyo qiimaha safarka.

English: Price each delivery by distance for every vehicle, and share it between the company and the courier.
am: ለእያንዳንዱ ተሽከርካሪ እያንዳንዱን ማድረሻ በርቀት ዋጋ ይወስኑ፣ እና በኩባንያው እና በተላላኪው መካከል ያካፍሉ።
om: Geessuu hunda fageenyaan konkolaataa hundaaf gatii kaa'i, dhaabbataa fi geessaa gidduutti qoodi.
ti: ነፍሲ ወከፍ ምቕራብ ብርሕቀት ንነፍሲ ወከፍ መጓዓዚ ዋጋ ሰይም፣ ኣብ ማእከል ኩባንያን ኣቕራቢን ኣካፍል።
so: U qiimee gaarsiin kasta masaafada baabuur kasta, oo u qaybi shirkadda iyo gaarsiiyaha.

English: Promo codes for orders and rides.
Refunds and the cash couriers hold.
am: ተመላሽ ገንዘቦች እና ተላላኪዎች የያዙት ጥሬ ገንዘብ።
om: Deebii maallaqaa fi maallaqa harkaa geessitoonni qaban.
ti: ዝምለስ ገንዘብን ኣቕራብቲ ዝሓዝዎ ጥረ ገንዘብን።
so: Lacag celinta iyo lacagta caddaanka ah ee gaarsiiyeyaashu haystaan.
Lacag bixinno la hubiyo oo la xaqiijiyo.

English: Ride requests waiting, drivers online, SOS: right now.
am: የሚጠብቁ የጉዞ ጥያቄዎች፣ በመስመር ላይ ያሉ ሾፌሮች፣ SOS፦ አሁን።
om: Gaaffii imalaa eegaa jiran, konkolaachisoota toora irra jiran, SOS: amma.
ti: ዝጽበዩ ሕቶ ጉዕዞ፣ ኣብ መስመር ዘለዉ ሾፌራት፣ SOS፦ ሕጂ።
so: Codsiyada safarka sugaya, darawallada online ah, SOS: hadda.

English: Drivers on a live map, approvals, suspend, add a driver.
am: ሾፌሮች በቀጥታ ካርታ ላይ፣ ማጽደቂያ፣ ማገድ፣ ሾፌር መጨመር።
om: Konkolaachisoota kaartaa kallattii irratti, mirkaneessa, dhaabuu, konkolaachisaa dabaluu.
ti: ሾፌራት ኣብ ቀጥታዊ ካርታ፣ ምጽዳቕ፣ ምእጋድ፣ ሾፌር ምውሳኽ።
so: Darawallada khariidad toos ah, ogolaansho, hakin, ku dar darawal.

English: What drivers see in their Pull tab: far waiting trips, VIP and sweet areas.
am: ሾፌሮች በPull ትር የሚያዩት፦ ሩቅ የሚጠብቁ ጉዞዎች፣ VIP እና ጣፋጭ አካባቢዎች።
om: Wanti konkolaachisoonni Pull tab isaaniitti argan: imala fageenyaan eegaa jiru, VIP fi naannoowwan mi'aawaa.
ti: ሾፌራት ኣብ Pull ትር ዝርእይዎ፦ ርሑቕ ዝጽበዩ ጉዕዞታት፣ VIP ከምኡ ጥዑም ቦታታት።
so: Waxa darawalladu ku arkaan Pull tab: safarrada fog ee sugaya, VIP iyo meelaha macaan.

English: All rides, fares, receipts, cancel or finish a ride.
am: ሁሉም ጉዞዎች፣ ዋጋዎች፣ ደረሰኞች፣ ጉዞ መሰረዝ ወይም ማጠናቀቅ።
om: Imala hunda, gatii, ragaa kaffaltii, imala haquu yookaan xumuruu.
ti: ኩሉ ጉዕዞታት፣ ዋጋታት፣ ቅብሊታት፣ ጉዕዞ ምስራዝ ወይ ምውዳእ።
so: Dhammaan safarrada, qiimaha, rasiidhada, tirtir ama dhammee safar.

English: Driver documents, expired papers, fake GPS checks.
am: የሾፌር ሰነዶች፣ ጊዜያቸው ያለፈ ወረቀቶች፣ የሐሰት GPS ፍተሻ።
om: Sanadoota konkolaachisaa, waraqaa yeroon isaa darbe, qoranoo GPS sobaa.
ti: ሰነዳት ሾፌር፣ ግዜኦም ዝሓለፈ ወረቓቕቲ፣ ምርመራ ሓሶት GPS።
so: Dukumeentiyada darawalka, waraaqaha dhacay, hubinta GPS been ah.

English: Agents who book rides and bring in drivers.
am: ጉዞ የሚያስይዙ እና ሾፌሮችን የሚያመጡ ወኪሎች።
om: Bakka bu'oota imala qabsiisanii konkolaachisoota fidan.
so: Wakiillada qoondeeya safarrada oo keena darawallada.
Lacag bixinta safarka, wallet-ka iyo tibaaxaha.

English: The numbers of the whole company.
Everyone with an account, by role.
om: Nama akkaawuntii qabu hundumaa, gahee irratti.
so: Qof kasta oo koonto leh, marka loo eego doorka.

English: Is the system ready to open? Checklist.
am: ሲስተሙ ለመክፈት ዝግጁ ነው? ዝርዝር ማረጋገጫ።
ti: ሲስተም ንምኽፋት ድሉው ድዩ? ዝርዝር መረጋገጺ።
so: Nidaamku ma diyaar u yahay furitaan? Liis hubineed.

English: What the ETEL phone app shows (owner).

om: Of eeggannoo: meeshaalee haaromsaa fi haquu.
so: Digniin: qalabka dib u dejinta iyo tirtirka.

English: Admin two-step sign-in (the code at the EtelID login page is separate: change it in the EtelID portal).
am: የአስተዳዳሪ ባለሁለት ደረጃ መግቢያ (በEtelID መግቢያ ገጽ ያለው ኮድ የተለየ ነው፤ በEtelID ፖርታል ይቀይሩት)።
om: Seensa tarkaanfii lama Admin (koodiin fuula seensa EtelID adda; poortaala EtelID keessatti jijjiiri).
ti: ባዕለ ክልተ ደረጃ መእተዊ ኣስተዳዳሪ (እቲ ኣብ ገጽ መእተዊ EtelID ዘሎ ኮድ ዝተፈለየ እዩ፤ ኣብ ፖርታል EtelID ቀይሮ)።
so: Gelitaanka laba tallaabo ee Admin (koodhka bogga gelitaanka EtelID waa kale: ka beddel albaabka EtelID).

English: Block attacks and people outside Ethiopia, sign out when not used, security log.
am: ጥቃቶችን እና ከኢትዮጵያ ውጭ ያሉ ሰዎችን አግድ፣ ሲቀመጥ ውጣ፣ የደህንነት መዝገብ።
om: Weeraraa fi namoota Itoophiyaa alaa gufuu, yeroo hin fayyadamne ba'uu, galmee nageenyaa.
ti: ተጻብኦን ካብ ኢትዮጵያ ወጻኢ ዘለዉ ሰባትን ኣዕግት፣ ዘይተጠቐምካ ኣብ ዝኾነሉ ግዜ ውጻእ፣ መዝገብ ድሕነት።
so: Xir weerarada iyo dadka Itoobiya ka baxsan, ka bax marka aan la isticmaalin, diiwaanka amniga.

English: Make text and buttons bigger or smaller.
am: ጽሑፍ እና አዝራሮችን ያሳድጉ ወይም ያሳንሱ።
om: Barruu fi qabduuwwan guddisi yookaan xiqqeessi.
so: Ka weyneey ama ka yaree qoraalka iyo badhamada.

English: Ride fares per vehicle, peak hours, driver goals, commission, incentives.
am: የጉዞ ዋጋ በተሽከርካሪ፣ የፍጥነት ሰዓታት፣ የሾፌር ግቦች፣ ኮሚሽን፣ ማበረታቻዎች።
om: Gatii imalaa konkolaataan, sa'aatii ol-aanaa, kaayyoo konkolaachisaa, komishinii, kakaasuu.
ti: ዋጋ ጉዕዞ ብመጓዓዚ፣ ሰዓታት ብዙሕ ሓላፍነት፣ ዕላማ ሾፌር፣ ኮሚሽን፣ ምትብባዕ።
so: Qiimaha safarka baabuur kasta, saacadaha ugu mashquulka badan, hadafyada darawalka, komishinka, dhiirigelinta.

English: Delivery fees and zones, vehicle fees, courier pay, bank accounts.
am: የማድረሻ ክፍያዎች እና ዞኖች፣ የተሽከርካሪ ክፍያዎች፣ የተላላኪ ክፍያ፣ የባንክ ሂሳቦች።
om: Kaffaltii geessuu fi aanaalee, kaffaltii konkolaataa, kaffaltii geessaa, herrega baankii.
ti: ክፍሊት ምቕራብን ዞናትን፣ ክፍሊት መጓዓዚ፣ ክፍሊት ኣቕራቢ፣ ሂሳብ ባንክ።
so: Khidmadaha gaarsiinta iyo aagagga, khidmadaha baabuurta, mushaharka gaarsiiyaha, koontooyinka bangiga.
Qaybinta dalabyada marka loo eego xaalad
Muuji kuwa aan la akhrin oo keliya

English: Waiting for the customer to pay
so: Waxaa la sugayaa macmiilka inuu bixiyo
Dalab kale oo socda ma jiro.

am: በመጠባበቅ ላይ ያለ ማረጋገጫ የለም — ሁሉ ንጹህ ✓
om: Mirkaneessi eegaa jiru hin jiru — hundi ifaadha ✓
so: Xaqiijin sugaya ma jiro — wax walba waa nadiif ✓

om: Hanga ammaatti galmeen mirkaneessaa hin jiru
so: Weli diiwaan xaqiijin ah ma jiro

English: No approved courier is available to assign.
so: Gaarsiiye la ogolaaday oo la qoondeeyo ma jiro.
Wax go'aan looga baahan ma jiro.
Gaarsiin maalintii, 14-kii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay

English: The courier signs in to the Courier app with this phone and password.
am: ተላላኪው በዚህ ስልክ እና የይለፍ ቃል ወደ የተላላኪ መተግበሪያ ይገባል።
om: Geessaan appii Geessaa kana bilbilaa fi jecha darbii kanaan seena.
ti: እቲ ኣቕራቢ ብዚ ተሌፎንን ሕሉፍ ቃልን ናብ ኣፕ ኣቕራቢ ይኣቱ።
so: Gaarsiiyuhu wuxuu ku galaa app-ka Gaarsiiyaha taleefankan iyo erayga sirta ah.

English: The vehicle decides which jobs they are offered.
so: Baabuurku wuxuu go'aamiyaa shaqooyinka loo soo bandhigo.

English: A motorcycle courier needs a valid licence.
am: የሞተር ሳይክል ተላላኪ ትክክለኛ ፈቃድ ያስፈልገዋል።
ti: ናይ ሞተር ኣቕራቢ ቅኑዕ ፍቓድ የድልዮ።
so: Gaarsiiyaha mootada wuxuu u baahan yahay shati sax ah.

English: This ID number is already registered to another courier
am: ይህ የመታወቂያ ቁጥር ለሌላ ተላላኪ ተመዝግቧል
om: Lakkoofsi ID kun geessaa biraaf galmaa'eera
ti: እዚ ቁጽሪ መንነት ንካልእ ኣቕራቢ ተመዝጊቡ
so: Lambarkan ID ayaa horey loogu diiwaangeliyay gaarsiiye kale

English: Register a courier step by step

so: Marka kor u kaca la dabaqo

English: Change the pay of one order
Delivery price by distance and weight
Express delivery and the booking switch
am: ፈጣን ማድረስ እና የቦታ ማስያዣ መቀየሪያ

English: How a package price is worked out

so: Xirmooyinka ka culus waa la diidaa

English: Copy a menu to another shop

so: Gelitaanka Admin ayaa loo baahan yahay

English: Sign in with your admin Etel-ID to access WP Admin.
am: WP Adminን ለመድረስ በአስተዳዳሪ Etel-ID ይግቡ።
om: WP Admin seenuuf Etel-ID admin keetiin seeni.
ti: ናብ WP Admin ንምእታው ብEtel-ID ኣስተዳዳሪ ኣእቱ።
so: Ku gal Etel-ID admin-kaaga si aad u gasho WP Admin.

English: From your authenticator app. Lost your phone? Type one of your backup codes.
am: ከማረጋገጫ መተግበሪያዎ። ስልክዎ ጠፍቷል? ከመጠባበቂያ ኮዶችዎ አንዱን ይጻፉ።
om: Appii mirkaneessaa keetii irraa. Bilbilli kee badee? Koodii kuusaa keessaa tokko galchi.
ti: ካብ ኣፕ መረጋገጺኻ። ተሌፎንካ ጠፊኡ ድዩ? ሓደ ካብ ኮዳት መሕለፊኻ ጸሓፍ።
so: Ka app-ka xaqiijiyahaaga. Taleefankaaga ma lumay? Qor mid ka mid ah koodhadhka keydka.

English: Keep me signed in for 30 days
Enter the phone number or Etel-ID on your account
am: በመለያዎ ላይ ያለውን ስልክ ቁጥር ወይም Etel-ID ያስገቡ
om: Lakkoofsa bilbilaa yookaan Etel-ID akkaawuntii kee irra jiru galchi
ti: ኣብ ኣካውንትካ ዘሎ ቁጽሪ ተሌፎን ወይ Etel-ID የእትው
so: Geli lambarka taleefanka ama Etel-ID ee koontadaada

English: We'll send a 6-digit code to your email or Telegram if you've linked either — otherwise we'll send it straight to your phone via WhatsApp or SMS.
am: ከሁለቱ አንዱን ካገናኙ የ6 ቁጥር ኮድ ወደ ኢሜይልዎ ወይም ቴሌግራምዎ እንልካለን — ካልሆነ በWhatsApp ወይም በSMS በቀጥታ ወደ ስልክዎ እንልካለን።
om: Yoo isaan tokko walitti hidhatte koodii lakkoofsa 6 imeelii yookaan Telegram keetti ergina — yoo hin taane WhatsApp yookaan SMS'n kallattiin bilbila keetti ergina.
ti: ሓደ ካብዞም ክልተ እንተ ኣተሓሒዝካ ኮድ 6 ቁጽሪ ናብ ኢመይልካ ወይ ቴሌግራምካ ንሰድድ — እንተ ዘይኮነ ብWhatsApp ወይ SMS ቀጥታ ናብ ተሌፎንካ ንሰድድ።
so: Waxaan ku diraynaa koodh 6 lambar ah iimaylkaaga ama Telegram haddii aad xidhiidhisay — haddii kale si toos ah ayaan ugu direynaa taleefankaaga WhatsApp ama SMS.

English: Enter the code we sent you, and choose a new password
am: የላክንልዎትን ኮድ ያስገቡ እና አዲስ የይለፍ ቃል ይምረጡ
om: Koodii siif ergine galchiitii jecha darbii haaraa filadhu
ti: ዝሰደድናልካ ኮድ የእትው ሓድሽ ሕሉፍ ቃል ድማ ምረጽ
so: Geli koodhka aan kuu dirnay oo dooro erayga sirta cusub

English: Your new password is active. You can sign in now.
am: አዲሱ የይለፍ ቃልዎ ንቁ ነው። አሁን መግባት ይችላሉ።
om: Jechi darbii kee haaraan hojiirra jira. Amma seenuu dandeessa.
ti: ሓድሽ ሕሉፍ ቃልካ ንጡፍ እዩ። ሕጂ ክትኣቱ ትኽእል ኢኻ።
so: Erayga sirtaada cusub waa shaqaynayaa. Hadda waad gali kartaa.

English: How would you like to register?
Pick one - you can always finish the rest later either way
am: አንዱን ይምረጡ - ቀሪውን በኋላ መጨረስ ይችላሉ
om: Tokko filadhu - kan hafe booda xumuruu dandeessa
ti: ሓደ ምረጽ - እቲ ዝተረፈ ድሕሪ ደሓር ክትውድኦ ትኽእል
so: Dooro mid - inta kale waad dhammayn kartaa dambe

English: Personal details, address, and ID verification in one go - about 4 minutes.
am: የግል ዝርዝር፣ አድራሻ እና የመታወቂያ ማረጋገጫ በአንድ ጊዜ - ወደ 4 ደቂቃ።
om: Odeeffannoo dhuunfaa, teessoo fi mirkaneessa ID al tokkoon - daqiiqaa 4 ta'a.
ti: ውልቃዊ ዝርዝር፣ ኣድራሻን መረጋገጺ መንነትን ብሓደ ግዜ - ኣስታት 4 ደቓይቕ።
so: Faahfaahin shakhsi ah, cinwaan iyo xaqiijinta ID hal mar - ku dhawaad 4 daqiiqo.

English: Please fill in all required fields.
so: Fadlan buuxi dhammaan meelaha loo baahan yahay.

English: Just your name and phone - add your photo and Fayda ID later
am: ስምዎን እና ስልክዎን ብቻ - ፎቶዎን እና ፋይዳ መታወቂያዎን በኋላ ይጨምሩ
om: Maqaa fi bilbila kee qofa - suuraa fi ID Faydaa booda dabali
ti: ስምካን ተሌፎንካን ጥራይ - ፎቶካን ፋይዳ መንነትካን ድሕሪ ደሓር ወስኽ
so: Magacaaga iyo taleefankaaga oo keliya - ku dar sawirka iyo Fayda ID dambe

English: Confirm your details before issuing your Etel-ID
om: Etel-ID kennuun dura tarreeffama kee mirkaneessi
so: Xaqiiji faahfaahintaada ka hor inta aan la bixin Etel-ID

English: Save your temporary password below - you'll need it to sign in and set a real one.
am: ከታች ያለውን ጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ያስቀምጡ - ለመግባት እና እውነተኛውን ለማዘጋጀት ያስፈልግዎታል።
om: Jecha darbii yeroo gad kaa'i - seenuuf fi kan dhugaa kaa'uuf si barbaachisa.
ti: ኣብ ታሕቲ ዘሎ ግዚያዊ ሕሉፍ ቃል ዓቅብ - ንምእታውን ሓቀኛ ንምምዳብን የድልየካ።
so: Keydi erayga sirta ku meel gaarka ah hoose - wuxuu kaaga baahan yahay si aad u gasho oo aad u dhigto mid dhab ah.
Erayga sirta ku meel gaarka ah

English: Your full name, date of birth, and contact details
am: ሙሉ ስምዎ፣ የትውልድ ቀንዎ እና የመገናኛ ዝርዝርዎ
om: Maqaa guutuu, guyyaa dhalootaa fi tarreeffama quunnamtii kee
ti: ምሉእ ስምካ፣ ዕለት ልደትካን ዝርዝር ርክብካን
so: Magacaaga oo dhan, taariikhda dhalashada iyo faahfaahinta xiriirka

English: Your Etel-ID is limited to Ride
am: Etel-ID ዎ ለRide ብቻ የተገደበ ነው
ti: Etel-ID ናትካ ንRide ጥራይ ዝተገድበ እዩ
so: Etel-ID-gaaga waa ku xaddidan yahay Ride oo keliya

English: Add the items below to unlock Delivery, Market, Pay and every other Etel service. Ride keeps working in the meantime.
am: Delivery፣ Market፣ Pay እና ሌሎች የኢትኤል አገልግሎቶችን ለመክፈት ከታች ያሉትን ያክሉ። Ride በዚህ መሃል መስራቱን ይቀጥላል።
om: Delivery, Market, Pay fi tajaajilawwan Etel kan biroo banuuf kanneen gadii dabali. Ride yeroo kanatti hojjechuu itti fufa.
ti: Delivery፣ Market፣ Pay ከምኡውን ካልኦት ኣገልግሎታት ኢትኤል ንምኽፋት ነዞም ኣብ ታሕቲ ዘለዉ ወስኽ። Ride ኣብዚ እዋን ምስራሕ ይቕጽል።
so: Ku dar waxyaabaha hoose si aad u furto Delivery, Market, Pay iyo adeegyada kale ee Etel. Ride wuu sii shaqaynayaa xilligan.
Heer sare oo aan la heshiin
Isku mid ah hoos hal aqoonsi
Aqoonsi dhijitaal ah oo la midoobay

om: Maal akka ta'aa jiru nutti himi…
Barruu, mallattoowwan, qabduuwwan fi mallattoo daldalaa

am: ሱቆችን፣ ትዕዛዞችን እና ዋጋዎችን እንደገና ጫን
om: Suuqota, ajajoota fi gatii irra deebi'ii fe'i
so: Dib u rar dukaamada, dalabyada iyo qiimaha

English: Choose how Etel Pay checks you
om: Etel Pay akkamitti si mirkaneessu filadhu
ti: ኢትኤል ፔይ ከመይ ከም ዘረጋግጸካ ምረጽ
so: Dooro sida Etel Pay kuu hubiyo

English: Ethiopia's most ambitious holding group — uniting commerce, logistics, finance, and culture under a single sovereign identity.
om: Gareen qabeenya Itoophiyaa kan hawwii guddaa qabu — daldala, loojistiksii, faayinaansii fi aadaa eenyummaa bulchaa tokko jalatti walitti fidu.
ti: ዝዓቢ ድልየት ዘለዎ ናይ ኢትዮጵያ ሆልዲንግ ጉጅለ — ንግዲ፣ ሎጂስቲክስ፣ ፋይናንስን ባህልን ኣብ ትሕቲ ሓደ ልዑላዊ መንነት ዘሓድር።
so: Kooxda ugu hammuunsan Itoobiya — ku midaysa ganacsiga, saadaasha, maaliyadda iyo dhaqanka hoos hal aqoonsi madax-bannaan.
Siddeed shirkadood oo hoos yimaada. Hal koox.

English: Gas queue management transforms fuel distribution across the city.
om: Bulchiinsi tarree gaazii raabsa boba'aa magaalaa guutuu jijjiira.
ti: ምምሕዳር ጸፍ ጋዝ ዕደላ ነዳዲ ኣብ ኩላ ከተማ ይቕይር።
so: Maaraynta safka gaaska ayaa beddelaysa qaybinta shidaalka magaalada oo dhan.

English: Real-time logistics platform with Addis Ababa zone mapping deployed.
om: Marsariitiin loojistiksii yeroo dhugaa kaartaa aanaalee Finfinnee wajjin hojiirra oolfameera.
ti: ቀጥታዊ ሎጂስቲክስ መድረኽ ምስ ካርታ ዞናት ኣዲስ ኣበባ ተተኺሉ።
so: Madal saadaasha waqtiga dhabta ah oo leh khariidadaynta aagagga Addis Ababa ayaa la dhigay.

English: A unified digital identity tying all 8 subsidiaries under one membership.
om: Eenyummaan dijitaalaa tokko dhaabbilee xixiqqaa 8 miseensummaa tokko jalatti hidhu.
ti: ሓደ ዲጂታላዊ መንነት ንኩሎም 8 ንኡሳን ኩባንያታት ኣብ ትሕቲ ሓደ ኣባልነት ዘተሓሕዝ።
so: Aqoonsi dhijitaal ah oo ku xidha dhammaan 8-ka shirkadood hoos hal xubinnimo.

English: Etel Pay, LuxLine, Transport, Media — the full vision realised.
om: Etel Pay, LuxLine, Transport, Media — mul'anni guutuun dhugoome.
ti: ኢትኤል ፔይ፣ LuxLine፣ ትራንስፖርት፣ ሚድያ — እቲ ምሉእ ራእይ ተተሓዚ።
so: Etel Pay, LuxLine, Transport, Media — aragtida oo dhan ayaa la gaadhay.

English: Set the Group's direction across all subsidiaries, from Hawassa outward - strategy, capital allocation, and the founding vision.
om: Gara gareen dhaabbilee xixiqqaa hunda keessa Hawaasaa irraa gara alaatti kaa'a - tarsiimoo, ramaddii kaappitaalaa fi mul'ata hundeeffamaa.
ti: ኣንፈት ጉጅለ ኣብ ኩሎም ንኡሳን ኩባንያታት ካብ ሓዋሳ ንወጻኢ ሰይም - ስትራተጂ፣ ምዕዳል ካፒታልን ራእይ መስራቲን።
so: Dejiso jihada Kooxda dhammaan shirkadaha hoos yimaada, laga bilaabo Hawaasa - istaraatiijiyad, qoondaynta maalka iyo aragtida aasaasaha.

English: Runs day-to-day execution across the subsidiaries - logistics, staffing, and the operational discipline that keeps eight companies moving as one.
om: Hojii guyyaa guyyaa dhaabbilee xixiqqaa hunda keessa geggeessa - loojistiksii, hojjettoota fi sirna hojii dhaabbilee saddeet akka tokko deemsisu.
ti: ዕለታዊ ኣፈጻጽማ ኣብ ኩሎም ንኡሳን ኩባንያታት የካይድ - ሎጂስቲክስ፣ ሰራሕተኛታትን ሸሞንተ ኩባንያታት ከም ሓደ ዘንቀሳቕስ ስርዓት ስራሕን።
so: Wuxuu maamulaa hawlaha maalinlaha ah ee shirkadaha - saadaasha, shaqaalaynta iyo anshaxa hawlgalka ee ka dhigaya siddeed shirkadood inay u socdaan sidii mid.

English: Owns the shared platform underneath every subsidiary - Etel-ID, the internal APIs, and the security that binds them together.
om: Marsariitii waloo dhaabbilee xixiqqaa hunda jala jiru qabata - Etel-ID, API keessaa fi nageenya walitti hidhu.
ti: ነታ ኣብ ትሕቲ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ንኡስ ኩባንያ ዘላ ሓባራዊት መድረኽ ይውንን - Etel-ID፣ ውሽጣዊ API ታትን ኣሕዋስ ዘተሓሕዝ ድሕነትን።
so: Wuxuu leeyahay madasha la wadaago ee hoose shirkad kasta - Etel-ID, API-yada gudaha iyo amniga isku xidha.

English: For interviews, media kits, or partnership inquiries, our team responds directly — no press office runaround.
om: Af-gaaffii, meeshaalee miidiyaa yookaan gaaffii hirmaannaa, garreen keenya kallattiin deebisa — waajjira pireesii malee.
ti: ንቃለ-መሕተት፣ ሚድያ ኪት ወይ ሕቶታት ሽርክነት ጉጅለና ብቀጥታ ይምልስ — ብዘይ ቢሮ ፕሬስ ዝተጣመመ መገዲ።
so: Waraysiyo, qalabka warbaahinta ama weydiimaha iskaashiga, kooxdayadu si toos ah ayay u jawaabtaa — iyada oo aan la marin xafiis saxaafadeed.

English: A single verified identity that unlocks every Etel Group service — from fuel queue priority to luxury concierge, from same-day delivery to digital payments. One application. One card. Sovereign access.
om: Eenyummaa mirkanaa'e tokko tajaajila Gareen Etel hunda bana — dursa tarree boba'aa irraa hanga tajaajila dhuunfaa, geessuu guyyaa tokkoo irraa hanga kaffaltii dijitaalaatti. Iyyannoo tokko. Kaardii tokko. Seensa bulchaa.
ti: ሓደ ዝተረጋገጸ መንነት ንኩሉ ኣገልግሎት ጉጅለ ኢትኤል ይኸፍት — ካብ ቀዳምነት ጸፍ ነዳዲ ክሳብ ቅንጡዕ ኮንስየርጅ፣ ካብ ናይ ሓደ መዓልቲ ምቕራብ ክሳብ ዲጂታላዊ ክፍሊት። ሓደ ምዝገባ። ሓደ ካርድ። ልዑላዊ መእተዊ።
so: Aqoonsi keliya oo la xaqiijiyay oo furaya adeeg kasta oo Kooxda Etel — laga bilaabo mudnaanta safka shidaalka ilaa concierge raaxo leh, laga bilaabo gaarsiin maalinta isla maalinta ilaa lacag bixinta dhijitaalka ah. Hal codsi. Hal kaar. Gelitaan madax-bannaan.

English: One verified profile across all 8 Etel subsidiaries — no repeated KYC.
om: Piroofaayilii mirkanaa'e tokko dhaabbilee Etel xixiqqaa 8 hunda irratti — KYC irra deebi'amu malee.
ti: ሓደ ዝተረጋገጸ መግለጺ ኣብ ኩሎም 8 ንኡሳን ኩባንያታት ኢትኤል — ዳግመ KYC የለን።
so: Hal profile la xaqiijiyay dhammaan 8-ka shirkadood ee Etel — KYC dib loo celinayn ma jiro.

English: Linked wallet with Telebirr & CBE Birr — pay across the group instantly.
om: Waalet Telebirr fi CBE Birr wajjin walitti hidhame — gareen guutuu keessatti battalumatti kaffali.
ti: ዋሌት ምስ ቴሌብርን CBE ብርን ዝተተሓሓዘ — ኣብ ጉጅለ ብቅጽበት ክፈል።
so: Wallet ku xidhan Telebirr & CBE Birr — ku bixi koox dhan isla markiiba.

English: Founding → Gold → Platinum → Obsidian. Unlock exclusive benefits as you grow.
om: Hundeessaa → Warqee → Plaatinam → Obsidiyaan. Yeroo guddatu faayidaa addaa bani.
ti: መስራቲ → ወርቂ → ፕላቲነም → ኦብሲድያን። ክትዓቢ ከለኻ ፍሉይ ረብሓታት ክፈት።
so: Aasaasid → Dahab → Bilaatinam → Obsidian. Fur faa'iidooyin gaar ah marka aad koraysid.

English: Apply now to be recognised as a founding member — permanent on your card.
om: Amma iyyadhu akka miseensa hundeessaatti beekamuuf — kaardii kee irratti dhaabbataa.
ti: ከም መስራቲ ኣባል ንኽትፍለጥ ሕጂ ተመዝገብ — ኣብ ካርድካ ቀዋሚ።
so: Codso hadda si laguu aqoonsado xubin aasaasaha — joogto ah kaarkaaga.

English: Hosted at ethelmarket.com/EtelId — your data stays within the Etel ecosystem.
om: ethelmarket.com/EtelId irratti kuufama — daataan kee sirna Etel keessa turta.
ti: ኣብ ethelmarket.com/EtelId ዝተሓዘ — ዳታኻ ኣብ ውሽጢ ኢኮሲስተም ኢትኤል ይተርፍ።
so: Waxaa lagu hayaa ethelmarket.com/EtelId — xogtaadu waxay ku hadhaysaa nidaamka Etel.

English: Whether you're a potential partner, investor, job seeker, or simply curious about what Etel Group is building — we want to hear from you.
om: Hiriyaa dandeessu, invastarii, hojii barbaaduu, yookaan waan Gareen Etel ijaaruuf bira ta'ee hawwatu — nu dhageessisi.
ti: ተሓባባር፣ ወፃኢ፣ ስራሕ ደላይ ወይ እንታይ ከም ዝሃንጽ ጉጅለ ኢትኤል ዝፈቱ ሰብ ክንዲ ዝኸውን — ክንሰምዐካ ንደሊ።
so: Haddii aad tahay wada-hawlgale macquul ah, maalgashade, shaqo doon, ama si fudud u xiisaynayso waxa Kooxda Etel dhisayso — waxaan rabnaa inaan ku maqalno.

English: Each platform is powered by Etel-ID — one identity, every service.
om: Marsariitii hunduu Etel-ID'n hojjeta — eenyummaa tokko, tajaajila hunda.
ti: ነፍሲ ወከፍ መድረኽ ብEtel-ID ይሰርሕ — ሓደ መንነት፣ ኩሉ ኣገልግሎት።
so: Madal kasta waxaa shidaya Etel-ID — hal aqoonsi, adeeg kasta.

English: Real-time logistics across Addis Ababa zones
om: Loojistiksii yeroo dhugaa aanaalee Finfinnee keessatti
ti: ቀጥታዊ ሎጂስቲክስ ኣብ ዞናት ኣዲስ ኣበባ
so: Saadaasha waqtiga dhabta ah ee aagagga Addis Ababa

English: Gas queue management — in active development
so: Maaraynta safka gaaska — horumarid firfircoon ku jirta

om: Ijaarsi marsariitii daldala elektirooniksii adeemsa keessa
ti: ምህናጽ መድረኽ ኤሌክትሮኒክ ንግዲ ይቕጽል ኣሎ
so: Dhismaha madasha ganacsiga elektarooniga ah waa socdaa

om: Waalet faayinaansii teeknooloojii — sadarkaa karoorfannaa fi seeraa
so: Wallet fintech — heerka qorshaynta iyo xeerarka

om: Neetworkii imaltootaa magaalaa gidduu — karoora karaa
ti: መርበብ ተጓዓዝቲ ኣብ መንጎ ከተማታት — መደብ መንገዲ
so: Shabakadda rakaabka magaalooyinka u dhexeysa — qorshaynta dariiqa

om: Tajaajila dhuunfaa mi'aawaa — sadarkaa yaadaa fi mallattoo
so: Concierge raaxo leh — heerka fikradda iyo summadda

English: Messages are reviewed within 2 business days · ለ2 የስራ ቀናት ውስጥ ምላሽ ይሰጣሉ
ti: መልእኽትታት ኣብ ውሽጢ 2 መዓልቲ ስራሕ ይምርመሩ
so: Fariimaha waa la eegaa 2 maalmood oo shaqo gudahood

English: Your Etel-ID is limited to Ride.
am: Etel-ID ዎ ለRide ብቻ የተገደበ ነው።
ti: Etel-ID ናትካ ንRide ጥራይ ዝተገድበ እዩ።
so: Etel-ID-gaaga waa ku xidhan yahay Ride oo keliya.

English: Add your profile photo and both sides of your Fayda ID to unlock Delivery, Market, Pay and every other Etel service.
am: Delivery፣ Market፣ Pay እና ሌሎች የኢትኤል አገልግሎቶችን ለመክፈት የመገለጫ ፎቶዎን እና ሁለቱንም የፋይዳ መታወቂያ ገጾች ያክሉ።
om: Delivery, Market, Pay fi tajaajilawwan Etel kan biroo banuuf suuraa piroofaayilii fi fuula lamaan ID Faydaa dabali.
ti: Delivery፣ Market፣ Pay ከምኡውን ካልኦት ኣገልግሎታት ኢትኤል ንምኽፋት ፎቶ መግለጺኻን ክልቲኡ ገጻት ፋይዳ መንነትካን ወስኽ።
so: Ku dar sawirka profile-kaaga iyo labada dhinac ee Fayda ID si aad u furto Delivery, Market, Pay iyo adeegyada kale ee Etel.

English: Codes cannot be sent yet. Please contact Etel support to verify your number.
am: ኮዶች እስካሁን መላክ አይቻልም። ቁጥርዎን ለማረጋገጥ የኢትኤል ድጋፍን ያነጋግሩ።
om: Koodiin ammallee ergamuu hin danda'u. Maaloo lakkoofsa kee mirkaneessuuf deeggarsa Etel quunnami.
ti: ኮዳት ክሳብ ሕጂ ክሰደዱ ኣይክእሉን። ቁጽርካ ንምርግጋጽ ንደገፍ ኢትኤል ተወከስ።
so: Koodhadhka lama dirin karo weli. Fadlan la xidhiidh taageerada Etel si aad u xaqiijiso lambarkaaga.

English: Your account was created with a temporary password. Please set your own password to continue.
am: መለያዎ በጊዜያዊ የይለፍ ቃል ተፈጥሯል። ለመቀጠል የራስዎን የይለፍ ቃል ያዘጋጁ።
om: Akkaawuntiin kee jecha darbii yeroon uumame. Itti fufuuf jecha darbii kee mataa kee kaa'i.
ti: ኣካውንትካ ብግዚያዊ ሕሉፍ ቃል ተፈጢሩ። ንምቕጻል ናይ ባዕልኻ ሕሉፍ ቃል ኣዳሉ።
so: Koontadaada waxaa lagu sameeyay erayga sirta ku meel gaarka ah. Fadlan dhig erayga sirtaada si aad u sii socoto.
Erayga sirta ku meel gaarka ah
Iskaan si aad u xaqiijiso aqoonsiga

English: A code from your phone, on top of your password
om: Koodii bilbila keetii, jecha darbii kee irratti dabalataan
ti: ካብ ተሌፎንካ ኮድ ብተወሳኺ ሕሉፍ ቃልካ
so: Koodh taleefankaaga ah, marka lagu daro erayga sirtaada

English: Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only this one time.
am: ስልክዎ ከጠፋ እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ጊዜ ይሰራሉ። የሚታዩት አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ነው።
om: Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii al tokko hojjeta yoo bilbila kee dhabde. Al tokko qofa mul'atu.
ti: ተሌፎንካ እንተ ጠፊኡ ነፍሲ ወከፎም ሓንሳ ይሰርሑ። ሓንሳ ጥራይ ይርኣዩ።
so: Mid kasta wuxuu shaqeeyaa hal mar haddii aad lumiso taleefankaaga. Waxaa la tusayaa hal mar oo keliya.
Gelitaanka laba tallaabo ah waa shidan yahay.

English: Every Etel Group company in one place — what's live today, and what's coming next. Every one of them shares a single identity: your Etel‑ID.
am: ሁሉም የኢትኤል ቡድን ኩባንያዎች በአንድ ቦታ — ዛሬ ቀጥታ የሆኑት እና በመቀጠል የሚመጡት። ሁሉም አንድ ማንነት ይጋራሉ፦ የእርስዎ Etel‑ID።
om: Dhaabbileen Gareen Etel hundi iddoo tokkotti — kan har'a kallattii fi kan itti aanu dhufu. Hundi eenyummaa tokko wal-qooddatu: Etel‑ID kee.
ti: ኩሎም ኩባንያታት ጉጅለ ኢትኤል ኣብ ሓደ ቦታ — ሎሚ ቀጥታ ዘለዉን ቀጺሉ ዝመጽኡን። ኩሎም ሓደ መንነት ይካፈሉ፦ Etel‑ID ናትካ።
so: Shirkad kasta oo Kooxda Etel hal meel — kuwa maanta toos ah iyo kuwa soo socda. Dhammaantood waxay wadaagaan hal aqoonsi: Etel‑ID-gaaga.
Shirkadaha toos ah waa la rarayaa…

English: Could not load the live company list right now. Please refresh.
am: የቀጥታ ኩባንያ ዝርዝሩን አሁን መጫን አልተቻለም። እባክዎ ያድሱ።
om: Tarreen dhaabbilee kallattii amma fe'uu hin dandeenye. Maaloo haaromsi.
ti: ዝርዝር ቀጥታዊ ኩባንያታት ሕጂ ክጽዓን ኣይተኻእለን። በጃኻ ሓድስ።
so: Liiska shirkadaha toos ah hadda lama rari karin. Fadlan cusbooneysii.

English: Ethiopia's most ambitious holding group — all our companies, one sovereign identity, one vision.
am: የኢትዮጵያ እጅግ ታላቅ ምኞት ያለው የሆልዲንግ ቡድን — ሁሉም ኩባንያዎቻችን፣ አንድ ሉዓላዊ ማንነት፣ አንድ ራዕይ።
om: Gareen qabeenya Itoophiyaa hawwii guddaa qabu — dhaabbilee keenya hundi, eenyummaa bulchaa tokko, mul'ata tokko.
ti: ዝዓቢ ድልየት ዘለዎ ሆልዲንግ ጉጅለ ኢትዮጵያ — ኩሎም ኩባንያታትና፣ ሓደ ልዑላዊ መንነት፣ ሓደ ራእይ።
so: Kooxda ugu hammuunsan Itoobiya — dhammaan shirkadahayaga, hal aqoonsi madax-bannaan, hal aragti.

English: Package and food delivery logistics with live tracking for drivers and customers.
am: የጥቅል እና የምግብ ማድረሻ ሎጂስቲክስ ለሾፌሮች እና ለደንበኞች ቀጥታ ክትትል ጋር።
om: Loojistiksii geessuu ba'aa fi nyaataa hordoffii kallattii konkolaachisootaa fi maamiltootaaf wajjin.
ti: ሎጂስቲክስ ምቕራብ ጥቅልን ምግብን ምስ ቀጥታዊ ኽትትል ንሾፌራትን ዓማዊልን።
so: Saadaasha gaarsiinta xirmooyinka iyo cuntada oo leh la socod toos ah darawallada iyo macaamiisha.

English: One digital identity for every Etel Group service - sign in once, use everywhere.
am: ለእያንዳንዱ የኢትኤል ቡድን አገልግሎት አንድ ዲጂታል ማንነት - አንዴ ይግቡ፣ በሁሉም ቦታ ይጠቀሙ።
om: Eenyummaa dijitaalaa tokko tajaajila Gareen Etel hundaaf - al tokko seeni, iddoo hundatti fayyadami.
ti: ሓደ ዲጂታላዊ መንነት ንነፍሲ ወከፍ ኣገልግሎት ጉጅለ ኢትኤል - ሓንሳ እተው ኣብ ኩሉ ቦታ ተጠቐም።
so: Hal aqoonsi dhijitaal ah adeeg kasta oo Kooxda Etel — gal hal mar, isticmaal meel kasta.

English: Gas and fuel delivery with cylinder exchange, tracked orders, and same-day service.
am: የጋዝ እና የነዳጅ ማድረስ ከሲሊንደር ልውውጥ፣ ከተከታተሉ ትዕዛዞች እና ከተመሳሳይ ቀን አገልግሎት ጋር።
om: Geessuu gaazii fi boba'aa jijjiirraa silindaraa, ajajoota hordofaman fi tajaajila guyyaa tokkoo wajjin.
ti: ምቕራብ ጋዝን ነዳዲን ምስ ምልውዋጥ ሲሊንደር፣ ዝተኸታተሉ ትእዛዛትን ናይ ሓደ መዓልቲ ኣገልግሎትን።
so: Gaarsiinta gaaska iyo shidaalka oo leh beddelka sillindarka, dalabyo la raacay iyo adeeg isla maalinta.

English: General e-commerce marketplace for everyday goods across the region.
am: በክልሉ ላሉ የዕለት ተዕለት ዕቃዎች አጠቃላይ የኤሌክትሮኒክ ንግድ ገበያ።
om: Gabaa daldala elektirooniksii waliigalaa meeshaalee guyyaa guyyaa naannoo keessatti.
ti: ሓፈሻዊ ዕዳጋ ኤሌክትሮኒክ ንግዲ ንዕለታዊ ዕቃታት ኣብ ክልል።
so: Suuq guud oo ganacsi elektaroonig ah oo alaabta maalinlaha ah ee gobolka.

English: Digital wallet, merchant payments, and transfers across the Etel Group ecosystem.
am: ዲጂታል ዋሌት፣ የነጋዴ ክፍያዎች እና በኢትኤል ቡድን ሥነ ምህዳር ውስጥ ዝውውሮች።
om: Waalet dijitaalaa, kaffaltii daldaltootaa fi dabarsa ekoosistamii Gareen Etel keessatti.
ti: ዲጂታላዊ ዋሌት፣ ክፍሊት ነጋዶን ምስግጋራትን ኣብ ኢኮሲስተም ጉጅለ ኢትኤል።
so: Wallet dhijitaal ah, lacag bixinta ganacsatada iyo wareejinno nidaamka Kooxda Etel.
